column10: method for making a curcuminoid-containing drug delivery composition
column11: silica nanocarriers hybridized with superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticles (“spions”) and curcumin through equilibrium or enforced adsorption technique. methods for dual delivery of spions and curcumin to a target for diagnosis or therapy, for example, for spion-based magnetic resonance imaging or for targeted delivery of curcumin to a cell or tissue. the technique can be extend to co-precipitation of mixed metal oxide involving ni, mn, co and cu oxide. the calcination temperature can be varied from 500-900° c. the nanocombination is functionalized with chitosan, polyacrylic acid, plga or another agent to increase its biocompatibility in vivo.

column10: nano-composite hydrogel for radiosensitization after breast-conserving surgery for breast cancer and preparation method therefor
column11: a nano-composite hydrogel for radiosensitization after breast-conserving surgery for breast cancer and a preparation method therefor. the nano-composite hydrogel comprises a hydrogel loaded with mesoporus gold nanoparticles m@aunps. the preparation method is as follows: the starting materials include a modified chitosan solution, a modified hyaluronic acid solution, and m@aunps. m@aunps are dispersed in the modified hyaluronic acid solution and the modified chitosan solution is isovolumetrically mixed with the modified hyaluronic acid solution to give the hydrogel. an injectable hydrogel encapsulating nanoparticles. the injectable hydrogel has a structure uniformly encapsulating outer-layer modified gold nanoparticles, and is capable of implementing immunotherapy by means of the targeted sustained-release of therapeutic drugs and meanwhile achieving ray energy accumulation due to the higher atomic number of the gold nanoparticles, thereby effectively killing tumor cells at the tumor bed position. the strategy effectively reduces the radiation dose in the whole breast radiotherapy, and is beneficial to protecting normal tissues of the breast outside the tumor bed.

column10: amoxicillin clavulanate nasal spray
column11: this invention describes a novel, stable, fixed-dose, aqueous suspension of amoxicillin clavulanate for nasal administration to treat post-surgical nasal infections. the formulation leverages a unique combination of excipients, including mucoadhesive agents like chitosan, to enhance drug delivery and efficacy. key features include targeted delivery to the infection site, sustained release for reduced dosing frequency, and the ability to disrupt bacterial biofilms. this innovative approach addresses the limitations of current treatment options by providing effective local drug delivery, minimizing systemic side effects, and improving patient compliance.

column10: preparation and application of ros (reactive oxygen species) response type nanoparticles containing thioketal bonds
column11: the invention relates to preparation and application of ros (reactive oxygen species) responsive nanoparticles containing thioketal bonds, which can effectively solve the problems of poor biocompatibility, poor water solubility, uncontrollable release and the like of curcumin. the materials comprise curcumin, 4-carboxyphenylboronic acid, chitosan oligosaccharide and thioketal diacid. chitosan oligosaccharide is modified by 4-carboxyphenylboronic acid, and then thioketal diacid is cross-linked to obtain the ros responsive polymer. the polymer, curcumin and glucose oxidase are self-assembled in a solution to construct ros-responsive nanoparticles. according to the nanoparticles prepared by the invention, due to the introduction of ros-sensitive thioketal bonds and boric acid ester bonds, the controlled release of curcumin at a tumor part is realized under the stimulation of a tumor microenvironment. in addition, the encapsulated glucose oxidase can catalyze over-expressed glucose at tumor tissues to generate hydrogen peroxide, the ros concentration of tumor cells is increased, the drug release efficiency is enhanced, and the treatment effect of the drug on breast cancer is effectively improved.

column10: pine needle volatile oil sustained-release microcapsule and preparation method thereof

and mixing the single-layer microcapsule solution with a chitosan quaternary ammonium salt solution, carrying out ultrasonic treatment to uniformly emulsify the mixture, then carrying out constant-temperature oscillation, centrifugation, filtration and washing, adding a sodium alginate solution with the same amount as the chitosan quaternary ammonium salt, and repeating the steps to obtain the double-layer microcapsule. the process is simple to operate, green and environment-friendly, and automatic production can be realized. after the prepared single-layer microcapsule is placed in an indoor environment for 77 days, the volatile oil retention rate of the microcapsule can reach 70.8%; the volatile oil retention rate of the double-layer microcapsule can reach 59.8% after the double-layer microcapsule is baked in an oven at 100 deg c for 80 minutes. therefore, the prepared microcapsule has good slow-release performance, can effectively improve the problems of short fragrance retention time, easy volatilization, easy oxidative degradation and the like of the pine needle volatile oil, and provides theoretical support for research of the pine needle volatile oil slow-release microcapsule.

column10: preparation and application of osa modified starch nanocrystal microcapsule
column11: the invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of medicinal microcapsules, and particularly discloses preparation and application of osa modified starch nanocrystal microcapsules, which comprises the following steps: (1) taking waxy corn starch as a raw material, adding sulfuric acid, and carrying out hydrolysis reaction to obtain starch nanocrystals; (2) preparing a starch nanocrystal dispersion liquid, then dropwise adding an osa-ethanol solution, and carrying out esterification reaction at room temperature to obtain osa modified starch nanocrystals; and (3) mixing the osa-snc aqueous dispersion, chitosan, deionized water and vegetable oil, preparing the mixed solution into an emulsion by using a high-shear dispersion emulsifying machine, slowly adding a cross-linking agent into the emulsion under magnetic stirring, and carrying out a cross-linking reaction to obtain the microcapsule. the waxy corn starch with good biocompatibility is adopted as a raw material, the microcapsules with high mechanical strength are prepared through a pickering emulsion template method, the purpose of targeted release of active substances in the microcapsules in intestinal tracts can be achieved through in-vitro simulated digestion experiment verification, and the microcapsule has important significance for solving the problems in the field of drug delivery.

column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of a high-load oral paclitaxel capsule for colon slow release, and belongs to the field of porous starch drug loading. the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dropwise adding an ethanol solution of paclitaxel into a water phase, and drying to obtain amorphous paclitaxel microspheres; (2) redissolving the paclitaxel microspheres prepared in the step (1) into an ethanol solution, dispersing the porous starch into the ethanol solution for adsorption, then performing solvent volatilization in a drying oven, washing with the ethanol solution to remove unadsorbed paclitaxel, and centrifuging to obtain a precipitate, namely the paclitaxel-loaded porous starch; and (3) dispersing the paclitaxel-loaded porous starch prepared in the step (2) into a chitosan solution, dropwise adding the solution into a phytic acid solution, and stirring for 4 hours to obtain the coated capsule. the paclitaxel sustained-release capsule is green and environment-friendly, can greatly reduce the drug loss, efficiently loads paclitaxel and achieves the effect of slowly releasing paclitaxel in the colon.

column10: camptothecin loaded modified release microspheres for cancer chemotherapy
column11: abstract: in this research, chitosan microsphere loaded with drug camptothecin have been prepared. this entrapment of drug causes controlled release of the highly potent naturally derived drug. in this research, the effect of change in drug: polymer ratio and amount of cross-linking agent used, on the drug release have been studied. the formulations prepared with 10 ml cross-linking agent and those prepared with 20 ml cross-linking agent were evaluated for ph, drug entrapment, in vitro drug release, drug release kinetics study and stability testing. the cumulative drug release for the formulations, prepared with 10 ml cross-linking agent, fl, f2, and f3 was found to be 72.84%, 67.72% and 64.36% respectively. the percentage entrapment efficiency of formulation fl, f2 and f3 was found to be 67.31%, 60.55% and 55.33% respectively. the drug release kinetics studies suggest that in the formulations prepared with 10 ml cross-linking agent formulations fl, f2 and f3 the best fit model was zero order release kinetics. the 'n' value of korsmayer-peppas, which tells about the fickian or non-fickian diffusion mechanism, for the formulations fl, f2 and f3 was found to be less than 0.45 and thus followed fickian diffusion mechanism. all the formulations prepared either with 10 ml cross-linking agent or 20 ml cross linking agent had ph suitable for the use and were found to be stable and giving sustained drug release for around 10 hrs.

column10: thermosensitive hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention relates to a temperature-sensitive hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. the hydrogel is composed of heptanoic anhydride modified ethylene glycol chitosan, the heptanoic anhydride modified ethylene glycol chitosan temperature-sensitive hydrogel is prepared from ethylene glycol chitosan and heptanoic anhydride through a heptyl acylation reaction, and the molar ratio of reactants of heptanoic anhydride to amino groups on ethylene glycol chitosan is 0.1: 1-0.5: 1. the method is easily accepted by researchers, experiment operation can be carried out at room temperature, and raw materials are non-toxic. the heptanoic anhydride modified ethylene glycol chitosan prepared through a heptanoylation reaction has a thermo-sensitive sol-gel transition behavior, and by controlling factors such as reaction time, a molar ratio and a solution concentration, the heptanoic anhydride modified ethylene glycol chitosan can present a free flowing sol state and an approximate solid gel state when the temperature changes. in addition, the material has good biocompatibility and biodegradability, and has potential biological application performance in the medical field, cell detection and drug delivery systems (sustained-release drugs).

column10: biomedical temperature-sensitive hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention relates to a biomedical temperature-sensitive hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. the hydrogel is composed of octanoyl ethylene glycol chitosan, the octanoyl ethylene glycol chitosan is prepared from ethylene glycol chitosan and octanoic anhydride through octanoyl reaction, and the molar ratio of the reactant octanoic anhydride to amino groups on the ethylene glycol chitosan is 0.1: 1-1: 1. the method is simple, safe, mild in reaction condition and easier to accept by researchers. the capryloyl glycol chitosan prepared by the reaction has a thermo-sensitive sol-gel transition behavior, and can be in a freely flowing sol state at room temperature and converted into a gel state at body temperature by controlling factors such as reaction time, a molar ratio and the concentration of the capryloyl glycol chitosan solution, and in addition, the capryloyl glycol chitosan can be in a temperature-sensitive sol-gel transition state. the material has good thermosensitivity, biocompatibility and degradability, and has important application value in the aspects of biomedicine and drug sustained release carriers.

column10: polyelectrolyte multilayer film-calcium carbonate nano-drug carrier, and preparation method and application thereof
column11: the invention discloses a polyelectrolyte multilayer film-calcium carbonate nano-drug carrier, and a preparation method and application thereof. the polyelectrolyte multilayer film-calcium carbonate nano-drug carrier comprises a core part and a shell part, the core part is nano-sized calcium carbonate particles with a porous structure, the calcium carbonate nano-particles are used as a supporting core, the shell part is used as a supporting core, and polyelectrolyte chitosan/sodium alginate with good biocompatibility is modified on the surfaces of the calcium carbonate nano-particles through a layer-by-layer self-assembly method to form an ultrathin film structure with good biocompatibility, core deformation protection and drug sustained release effects. according to the invention, the gold nano-particles are electrostatically adsorbed on the polyelectrolyte multilayer film structure, so that the treatment drug carried by the nano-drug carrier can be effectively regulated and controlled to be quickly released under the photo-thermal action of near-infrared laser, and diseases are synergistically treated by virtue of local photo-thermal and controllable release of chemotherapeutic drugs, so that the toxic and side effects on the body are reduced.

column10: injectable temperature-sensitive drug sustained-release carrier hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of injectable temperature-sensitive drug sustained-release carrier hydrogel. the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) oxidizing primary alcohol groups at two ends of pluronic to obtain pluronic (f127-cho) with an aldehyde group at the end group; (2) adding f127-cho into ultrapure water, and stirring in an ice-water bath to prepare an f127-cho solution; (3) adding carboxymethyl chitosan into ultrapure water, stirring and dissolving to prepare a carboxymethyl chitosan solution; and (4) mixing the f127-cho solution and the carboxymethyl chitosan solution with the same volume, stirring at low temperature and low speed for 10-30 minutes, and reacting at 37 deg c for 12 hours to obtain the temperature-sensitive hydrogel. the preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple, mild in reaction condition and low in raw material cost. the hydrogel prepared by the invention has excellent injectable, temperature-sensitive and self-healing properties, and can form gel in situ at a focus as a drug sustained-release carrier, so that the release period, the utilization rate and the treatment effect of the drug are improved.

column10: preparation method of ph response type carboxymethyl chitosan/sodium alginate hydrogel ball

column10: preparation method of novel chitosan-based dual-network hydrogel
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of novel dual-network hydrogel. the method comprises the following steps: firstly, dissolving polyethylene glycol and maleimide acid in an organic solvent under the action of a dehydrating agent to prepare peg-mi; then adding the peg-m, chitosan, a hydrophilic monomer, a cross-linking agent and an photoinitiator into a beaker for dissolving, and conducting uniform stirring; and carrying out heating in a water bath for a period of time, forming a first network through a click reaction of amino and maleimide groups, performing irradiating under an ultraviolet lamp for a period of time, and forming a second network through photopolymerization, thereby obtaining the double-network hydrogel through a one-pot method. the preparation method provided by the invention is simple to operate, mild in conditions and controllable in process. the chitosan-based dual-network hydrogel prepared by the method can efficiently adsorb heavy metal ions, colored dyes and other substances in water, has antibacterial activity, and has wide application prospects in the fields of environmental governance, drug sustained release, tissue engineering and the like.

column11: the invention discloses a method for preparing semi-interpenetrating network antibacterial gel based on natural polymers through click reaction of amino and anhydride in water, which comprises the following steps: firstly, modifying natural polymers such as natural products cellulose, chitosan and the like by quaternary ammonium salt to obtain a polymer with antibacterial activity; loading metal silver by using halloysite to prepare nano particles with antibacterial activity, then dissolving quaternary ammonium salt natural macromolecules, nano particles and a copolymer containing acid anhydride and amino in water to form a uniform solution, obtaining hydrogel by using a click reaction between amino and acid anhydride in water, soaking in water to remove non-crosslinked components, and freeze-drying to obtain the aerogel with antibacterial activity. the gel is rapidly generated in water, the preparation process is simple, and the obtained gel has ph responsiveness and can be used in the fields of drug sustained release, tissue engineering, water treatment and the like.

column10: preparation method of chitosan/montmorillonite hybrid microsphere and application of chitosan/montmorillonite hybrid microsphere in sustained release of metacycline hydrochloride
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of a chitosan/montmorillonite hybrid microsphere and an application of the chitosan/montmorillonite hybrid microsphere in sustained release of metacyclinehydrochloride. the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing ctab (cetyltrimethyl ammonium bromide) modified montmorillonite by taking chitosan as a raw material, malonic acid asa cross-linking agent and ctab (cetyltrimethyl ammonium bromide) modified montmorillonite as a modifier and adopting an inverse emulsion polymerization method to prepare hybrid microspheres of chitosan intercalated montmorillonite; (2) dissolving chitosan in a 5.0% malonic acid solution to enable the concentration of chitosan to be 1.0-3.0%; and (3) adding ctab modified montmorillonite into the chitosan-malonic acid mixed solution, stirring in a water bath at 60 deg c for 2 hours, adding liquid paraffin, span-80, tween-80 and ethyl acetate, stirring for 0.5 hour, gradually dropwise adding a catalyst solution, stirring at 75 deg c for 4-5 hours, standing for cooling, discarding an upper oil phase, adjusting ph, performing suction filtration, washing, drying and grinding. according to the preparation method, malonic acid is used as a cross-linking agent for the first time, ctab modified montmorillonite is used as a modifier, chitosan is stably inserted into montmorillonite interlayers by virtue of amidation reaction between carboxyl and amino, the interlayer spacing is enlarged, and a better drug slow-release effect is achieved.

column11: the invention discloses an amino acid-chitosan nano-drug delivery system, a preparation method and application thereof. the drug delivery system comprises chitosan nano-microspheres and an amino acidactive ingredient packaged therein. the chitosan nano-microspheres contain chitosan oligosaccharide and sodium tripolyphosphate with a mass ratio of 100-150:1, and the encapsulation rate of amino acids is 30-40%. the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dissolving chitosan in deionized water to prepare a chitosan solution with a concentration of 10-50 mg/ml; (2) adding 10-100 mg/ml of amino acid to be loaded, mixing evenly and adjusting the ph value to 5-7 to prepare a mixed solution; and (3) stirring continuously for more than 30min, and dropwise adding a sodium tripolyphosphate aqueous solution with the concentration of 1-10 mg/ml until the mass ratio of chitosan to sodium tripolyphosphate is between 100-150: 1. the drug delivery system is applied to preparing brain-entering drugs.

column10: antibacterial chitosan microneedle and application thereof
column11: the invention discloses an antibacterial chitosan microneedle and application thereof. a preparation method of the antibacterial chitosan microneedle comprises the following steps: s1, dissolving chitosan in water, and carrying out vacuum defoaming to obtain a chitosan solution; s2, coating the chitosan solution obtained in the step s1 on a pdms microneedle mould, filling, drying and peeling to obtain the antibacterial chitosan microneedle. the microneedle has an effect of remarkably inhibiting growth of escherichia coli and staphylococcus aureus, can effectively prevent bacteria from enteringa body through a microchannel on the skin to cause bacterial infection, and solves a problem that the skin is easily infected with bacteria in a using process of a microneedle. in addition, the microneedle has simple preparation method and low cost, is biodegradable after piercing into the skin, and will not leave microneedle residues in the body, and has wide application prospects as a transdermal drug delivery carrier.

column10: water-soluble chitosan derivative and preparation method thereof

column10: in-situ injectable double-cross-linked hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention relates to an in-situ injectable double-cross-linked hydrogel and a preparation method thereof, wherein the hydrogel is an in-situ injectable double-cross-linked hydrogel, and is prepared from a sulfydryl-modified hexacylated ethylene glycol chitosan derivative and a double bond-modified hexacylated ethylene glycol chitosan derivative through thermosensitive hydrophobic interaction and michael addition reaction, and a molar ratio of the sulfydryl on the sulfydryl-modified hexacylated ethylene glycol chitosan derivative to the carbon-carbon double bond on the double bond-modifiedhexacylated ethylene glycol chitosan derivative is 1:1-5:1. according to the invention, the method overcomes a lot of obstacles associated with the development of injectable carriers, does not use monomer cross-linkers, catalysts, oxidants, initiators and organic solvents throughout the system, and further improves the mechanical strength by cross-linking the sulfydryl group and the carbon-carbondouble bond in the polymer network under physiological conditions; the double-cross-linked hydrogel obtained by the reaction has good mechanical performance, wherein the mechanical strength and the degradation rate are adjusted by controlling the cross-linking degree between the sulfydryl and the carbon-carbon double bond, and the mechanical property is greatly changed along with different reaction conditions, so that the application field of the double-cross-linked hydrogel is further expanded; and the material has good injectability and good biodegradability, and has potential application value in the fields of injectable drug sustained-release carriers and the like.

column10: preparation method and application of pharmaceutical composition loaded in mesoporous hydroxyapatite embedded with gadolinium ions
column11: the invention relates to a preparation method and application of a pharmaceutical composition loaded in mesoporous hydroxyapatite embedded with gadolinium ions. the pharmaceutical composition loaded in the mesoporous hydroxyapatite embedded with the gadolinium ions is capable of effectively solving the problems of low targeting, premature drug leakage in the gastrointestinal tract and lack of real-time monitoring during treatment of oral drug delivery systems, thereby realizing integration of programmed release and treatment monitoring of the oral drug delivery systems. the preparation methodof the pharmaceutical composition loaded in the mesoporous hydroxyapatite embedded with the gadolinium ions comprises the following steps: synthesizing mesoporous hydroxyapatite embedded with gadolinium ions by adopting means of chemical precipitation and hydrothermal synthesis; synchronously loading 5-fluorouracil and gefitinib onto nanoparticles by adopting a means of solution dipping; and then,sequentially linking chitosan and polyacrylic acid onto surfaces of the drug-loading nanoparticles by amido bonds, thereby obtaining the pharmaceutical composition loaded in the mesoporous hydroxyapatite embedded with the gadolinium ions, wherein particle size of the pharmaceutical composition loaded in the mesoporous hydroxyapatite embedded with the gadolinium ions is 150-200 nm. the preparationmethod of the pharmaceutical composition loaded in the mesoporous hydroxyapatite embedded with the gadolinium ions disclosed by the invention is free of use of template agents, stable, reliable, andlow in production cost; and the prepared pharmaceutical composition is capable of achieving programmed drug release functions in a delivery system, thereby reducing unnecessary release of drugs in healthy tissues. therefore, drug concentraiton in tumor lesions can be increased, thereby achieving great economic and social benefits.

column11: the invention discloses a high-permeability one-way waterproof film of fruits and vegetables and a preparation method thereof the high-permeability one-way waterproof film. the one-way waterproof filmis composed of a hydrogel film layer and a spinning film layer. the one-way waterproof film is prepared by the following methods: preparing a carboxymethyl chitosan solution; firstly dissolving genipin into pure water in advance, further adding the genipin into the carboxymethyl chitosan solution drop by drop, performing ultrasonic treatment to uniformly disperse the genipin into the solution, allowing the solution to stand for 4-12 hours to complete cross-linking, further adding ca(oh)2 and bacteriostatic substances, and fully dispersing the components so as to obtain a hydrogel solution; pouring the hydrogel solution into a glass plate, performing drying in a vacuum drying oven, and performing peeling so as to obtain a hydrogel film; and by taking an ethanol solution of ethyl celluloseand tween-80 as a spinning solution, performing electrostatic spinning on the hydrogel film until the spinning film completely covers the hydrogel film, so as to obtain the one-way waterproof film. the one-way waterproof film prepared by the invention can change gas permeability according to respiration of fruits and vegetables, and has good properties of moisturizing, moisture adjustment, waterproofness, air permeability and sustained release, and is capable of effectively prolonging the shelf life of fruits and vegetables.

column10: chili seedling culture method
column11: the invention belongs to the technical field of agriculture, in particular to a chili seedling culture method. the method includes the steps of firstly, soaking chili seeds in a nutrient solution, dipping into a chitosan solution for 3-4 seconds, and placing in a shady place to dry moisture on the surfaces of the seeds; secondly, mixing field soil and bagasse, adding a compound microbial agent, evenly stirring, and piling up in an environment of 20-25 deg c to perform fermentation to obtain a fermented substrate; thirdly, adding sustained-release fertilizer special for chili into the fermentedsubstrate, and evenly stirring to obtain a seedling culture medium; fourthly, planting the chili seeds processed in the first step into the seedling culture medium, covering with a layer of seedlingculture medium after sowing, and watering; transplanting after the seeds growth into chili seedlings. the chili seedling culture method has the advantages that seed vigor can be increased, seed germination can be promoted, contaminative microbes can be prevented, and the emergence rate of the chili seeds can be increased effectively; strong seedling culture can be promoted; by using the field soiland the bagasse as the main raw materials of the seedling culture medium, seedling culture cost is lowered greatly.

column10: complex treating agent for preventing eutrophic water bloom from bursting and preparation method
column11: the invention discloses a complex treating agent for preventing eutrophic water bloom from bursting and a preparation method. the complex treating agent is the mixture of sodium alginate embedded chitosan gel beads and sodium alginate/polyethylene glycol 4000 composite embedded nanometer calcium peroxide gel beads in mass ratio of 1: 0.5 to 2. the invention further discloses a method for preparingthe complex treating agent. the complex treating agent for treating the eutrophic water has the following advantages of effectively adsorbing phosphorous in water, and further adsorbing endogenous phosphorous released in the bottom sediment; adsorbing the organic matter in the water, increasing the dissolved oxygen concentration at the bottom of the riverway, providing aerobe good environment, and reaching an aim of biologically degrading the organic matter; and finally realizing the aim of preventing the eutrophic water bloom from bursting. the complex treating agent disclosed by the invention has a sustained release effect, and is capable of continuously adsorbing and treating pollutant and releasing oxygen, thereby enabling the water to maintain a good state.

column10: miconazole nitrate-chitosan sustained-release vaginal gel and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention relates to a miconazole nitrate-chitosan sustained-release vaginal gel and a preparation method thereof. the miconazole nitrate-chitosan sustained-release vaginal gel comprises miconazole nitrate, chitosan, polycarbophil, glycerin, glyceryl behenate, sodium benzoate, triethanolamine, an acetic acid solution with a mass fraction of 2% and injection water. the method comprises the following steps: preparation of a chitosan-acetic acid sohution; preparation of a polymer phase; preparation of an oil phase; preparation of a water phase; and preparation of a sustained-release capsule. according to the invention, good linear relation is obtained in a range of 0.050 to 0.80 mg/ml; an average recovery rate is 97.91% (wherein rsd is equal to 0.24%); within-day and day-to-day precision tests are carried out, and test results show that within-day precision and day-to-day precision are good; the prepared miconazole nitrate-chitosan sustained-release vaginal gel has accumulative release rates of 35.54%, 56.02% and 93.92% in 1 h, 2 h and 12 h, respecitively; and clinical data shows that the sustained-release vaginal gel has an effective rate of 95.83% in treatment of monilial vaginitis.

column10: amphiphilic chitosan derivative and drug carrier containing the same
column11: the present invention relates to an amphiphilic chitosan derivative and an emulsion material comprising the same. the chitosan derivative of the present invention is modified with a carboxymethyl group and a hexanoyl group and thus has amphiphilic properties. the chitosan derivative has excellent emulsifying properties and thus can be used as a material for a drug carrier. the chitosan derivative is represented by chemical formula 1. r_1 is ch_2cooh or h. r_2 is co(ch_2)_4ch_3, ch_2cooh, coch_3 or h. m represents an integer of 10-1,000. the drug carrier has a formulation of liposome, a micelle, emulsion, or a nanoparticle.

column10: disinfectant for aquatic product and preparation method of disinfectant
column11: the invention belongs to the field of veterinary drug preparations and particularly relates to a disinfectant for an aquatic product and a preparation method of the disinfectant. the disinfectant for the aquatic product contains the main active ingredients: glutaraldehyde and benzalkonium bromide, wherein glutaraldehyde is an aldehyde disinfectant and is capable of killing a bacterial reproductive body, spores, fungi and viruses; benzalkonium bromide is a double-long-chain cationic surfactant, and quaternary ammonium cations of the benzalkonium bromide are capable of actively attracting bacteria and viruses with negative charges, covering the surfaces and inhibiting bacterial metabolism to cause a permeability change of a film; benzalkonium bromide and glutaraldehyde are combined for achieve the synergistic effect; glutaraldehyde and benzalkonium bromide are uniformly distributed in vegetable gelatin, are more stable and do not easily generate low-temperature crystal; nano-particles with excellent dispersity are prepared from a gel through a high pressure homogenizer, so that the drug release surface area is increased; and chitosan and sodium alginate are not included in the nano-particles, and have the effect of controlled release, and the anti-virus effect is prolonged. the preparation method of the disinfectant for the aquatic product is simple in operation and suitable for industrial production.

column10: preparation method of cyclodextrin-polymer drug-loaded vesicle
column11: the invention relates to a preparation method of a cyclodextrin-polymer drug-loaded vesicle. the preparation method comprises the following steps: adopting chitosan-grafted cyclodextrin polymer and benzimidazole polycaprolactone as materials, respectively dissolving cs-g-cd and bm-pcl in a solvent to prepare a solution; adding drugs into the bm-pcl solution obtained in step 1), stirring and dissolving, then dripping the obtained bm-pcl solution into cs-g-cd solution under the stirring condition and at a speed of 1-2 drops/s, continuing to stir after the dripping is finished, carrying out distilled-water dialysis, and thus obtaining polymer drug-loaded vesicle. the preparation method has the advantages that the prepared polymer vesicle has strong drug-loading capability for hydrophilic and hydrophobic drugs and can realize high-efficiency loading and controlled release of the drugs; and the polymer vesicle has a hollow structure and is 100-200nm in particle size, and the size of the vesicle can be adjusted according to the proportion of two polymers, namely cs-g-cd and bm-pcl.

column10: humic acid capsule structure nutritional anti-freezing multi-element sustained-release microelement fertilizer and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses a humic acid capsule structure nutritional anti-freezing multi-element sustained-release microelement fertilizer and a preparation method thereof. the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving chitosan into a glacial acetic acid aqueous solution to prepare chitosan aqueous solution, sieving potassium humate, uniformly mixing the potassium humate and chitosan aqueous solution, adding urea, adjusting an acid-alkaline value and temperature, adding microbial flora, then adding a trace element solution, stirring, curing, emulsifying, reacting, washing, and drying to obtain the anti-freezing organic fertilizer containing macro and trace nutritional substances for the growth of plants. by sufficiently utilizing the chitosan cold-resistant and stress-resistant water-retaining and moisturizing performance of the chitosan, the nutritional fertilizer for crops in winter can be prepared; the humic acid is used as a preparation base material, the soil structure is improved, the netted structure and the sustained-release capacity are sufficiently played, and the internal nutritional substances can be gradually released; and by adding the microbial flora, the resource waste is reduced, and the consumption of the chemical fertilizer is reduced. the resource waste and environmental pollution caused by the traditional fertilizer can be reduced, and the environmental benefit and social benefit are good.

column10: acid soil modifying agent
column11: the invention relates to an acid soil modifying agent. the modifying agent is prepared from plant ash, gypsum, laminaria residues, chitosan and sludge activated carbon by the following steps: putting the plant ash, gypsum, laminaria residues, chitosan and sludge activated carbon into a stirrer according to a certain proportion; adding a proper amount of water into the stirrer, stirring for 10-12 hours, and drying to obtain a mixture; and performing ball milling on the mixture for 2-3 hours through a ball mill to obtain the modifying agent. according to the acid soil modifying agent, the plant ash can react with acid soil to reduce the acidity of soil; after the plant ash and slurry activated carbon are mixed, the plant ash is adsorbed into pores of slurry activated carbon, and the plant ash can only permeate to the outside from the pores of the slurry activated carbon gradually, so that the slurry activated carbon has a sustained-release effect for the plant ash. furthermore, the slurry activated carbon can be used for adsorbing heavy metal ions in the soil, so that the concentration of heavy metal ions in the soil can be reduced.

column10: sustained-release microbial compound fertilizer and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention provides a sustained-release microbial compound fertilizer and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of fertilizer production. the compound fertilizer comprises 160 parts of a fertilizer core and 3 to 5 parts of a coating that coats the fertilizer core. the fertilizer core comprises, by weight, 8 to 25 parts of polyacrylamide, 5 to 10 parts of tryptophan, 5 to 10 parts of threonine, 2 to 7 parts of sodium trimetaphosphate, 3 to 8 parts of sodium tripolyphosphate, 3 to 5 parts of edta and 50 to 60 parts of a microbial compound. the coating comprises, by weight, 2 to 6 parts of gelatin, 1 to 6 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, 20 to 40 parts of urea, 5 to 25 parts of ferrous sulfate, 5 to 25 parts of zinc sulfate, 3 to 5 parts of rice stalk, 15 to 25 parts of high-polymer chitosan and 30 to 55 parts of water. the sustained-release microbial compound fertilizer is high in fertilizer efficiency, ecologically safe, simple to prepare, low in cost and suitable for large-scale production.

column10: composite drug carrier and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses a composite drug carrier and a preparation method thereof. the drug carrier adopts hyaluronic acid as the matrix, the matrix is internally loaded with a composite material, which is a condensation product of sericin, chitosan and polyvinyl alcohol/styryl pyridinium in a mass ratio of 4-9:1-5:3-7. the method consists of the processes of: matrix solution preparation, sericin crude extraction, sericin purification, composite material preparation and finished product preparation. the composite drug carrier provided by the invention has a series of excellent characteristics, like appropriate mechanical strength, special rheological properties, good stability and targeting ability. the composite drug carrier provided by the invention has good stability, and is insensitive to strong acid and alkali, heat, free radicals and hyaluronidase.

column10: biomass charcoal particles loaded with matrine-chitosan sustained-release microspheres and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses biomass charcoal particles loaded with matrine-chitosan sustained-release microspheres and a preparation method thereof. the preparation method is characterized in that adopting ultrasonic extraction and microwave extraction combined technology and chloroform extraction to extract and separate matrine; performing glutaraldehyde and chitosan in-situ crosslinking on the surface of matrine to obtain matrine coated chitosan sustained-release microspheres; loading the chitosan sustained-release microspheres on the surfaces of biomass charcoal particles through action between maleic anhydride and the chitosan sustained-release microspheres and hydroxyl on the surfaces of the biomass charcoal particles to obtain the biomass charcoal particles loaded with the matrine-chitosan sustained-release microspheres. the biomass charcoal particles loaded with the matrine-chitosan sustained-release microspheres have broad-spectrum insecticidal property, can improve soil structure, increase soil organic matter and adjust soil microenvironment, and can serve as a high-quality energy source and a soil improver to be applied in the aspects of water source purification and soil improvement.

column11: the invention discloses a porous sustained-release preparation with lactoglobulin modified by chitosan quaternary ammonium salt, and relates to the technical field of human-papilloma-virus-resistant sustained-release medicine administration. the porous sustained-release preparation comprises, by weight, 5-10 parts of polyethylene glycol-polylactide-glycolide, 80-90 parts of pore-forming agents and 2-5 parts of lactoglobulin modified by the chitosan quaternary ammonium salt. the chitosan quaternary ammonium salt and lactoglobulin are subjected to reaction at the temperature of 50-80 deg c to obtain the lactoglobulin modified by the chitosan quaternary ammonium salt. the porous sustained-release preparation has the advantages that the porous sustained-release preparation comprises the polyethylene glycol-polylactide-glycolide, the pore-forming agents and the lactoglobulin modified by the chitosan quaternary ammonium salt, the lactoglobulin modified by the chitosan quaternary ammonium salt is obtained by the aid of a method for polymerizing the chitosan quaternary ammonium salt and the lactoglobulin, multiple sterilization properties of the chitosan quaternary ammonium salt and the specificity of the lactoglobulin are reserved in polymers, accordingly, the dna (deoxyribonucleic acid) replication activity of human papilloma viruses can be inhibited, and the medicine administration effectiveness can be improved.

column10: efficient magnetic slow controlled-release fertilizer capable of promoting growth and development of cotton plants and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses an efficient magnetic slow controlled-release fertilizer capable of promoting growth and development of cotton plants. the efficient magnetic slow controlled-release fertilizer comprises the following components: a shrimp shell meal biomass fuel, iron tailing mineral sand, fe3o4 iron ore concentrate powder, mesoporous phosphopeptide, seaweed residues, citric acid residues, coconut meal, rubber seed meal, sodium bicarbonate, beer yeast, sodium alginate, vitamin c phosphate, phytase, tryptophan, lysine sodium, calcium citrate, methylcellulose, chitosan sodium polyacrylate hydrogel, nano magnetic liquid and the like. a coating material with effects of magnetic slow release and release promotion is adopted to wrap a fermented granular fertilizer, which is prepared from the seaweed residues, the citric acid residues, the coconut meal and the rubber seed meal in combination with a nutrient solution, so as to prepare a magnetic slow-release fertilizer. the fertilizer is rich in nutrient, and meanwhile, by virtue of a magnetic adsorption effect, the fertilizer effectively improves the dry matter quantity and the biomass of stems and roots of the cotton plants, obviously improves the plant height, increases the numbers of branches, flowers and cotton bolls of a single plant, and also increases the concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium in cotton tissues at the same time.

column10: gsh (glutathione) responsive controlled-release nano-pesticide formulation and preparation method and application thereof
column11: the invention relates to a gsh (glutathione) responsive controlled-release nano-pesticide formulation and a preparation method and application thereof. a controlled-release effective component of the pesticide formulation is a disulfide bond cross-linked carboxymethyl chitosan derivative, and the gsh responsive controlled-release nano-pesticide formulation is obtained through simultaneously dispersing the derivative and a pesticide into water, and performing ultrasonic oxidation on a sulfhydryl group. the preparation method of the pesticide formulation comprises preparation of a carboxymethyl chitosan aqueous solution, preparation of a 11-sulfhydryl undecanoic acid organic solution activated by edc hcl and nhs, preparation of a sulfhydryl carboxymethyl chitosan derivative and preparation of the gsh responsive disulfide bond cross-linked controlled-release nano-pesticide formulation. the pesticide formulation provided by the invention can act on the surface of a plant of agriculture and forestry or in soil through spraying or sprinkling, and a pesticide is hardly released before the nano-pesticide formulation reaches a target plant or ethers into a pest; after reaching the target plant or entering into the pest, the nano-pesticide formulation responses to intracellular gsh irritation to release the pesticide.

column10: polyelectrolyte compound hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention relates to polyelectrolyte compound hydrogel and a preparation method thereof and mainly relates to the field of high polymer materials. according to the method, chitosan and polyacrylic acid are dissolved in solvents containing koh, lioh*h2o and co(nh2)2, and a chitosan solution and a polyacrylic acid solution are obtained; the two solutions are blended, a certain amount of epichlorohydrin is added, the mixture is stirred for certain time and subjected to centrifugal defoaming, a product is sucked into an injector for consolidation forming, and the polyelectrolyte compound hydrogel taking chitosan and polyacrylic acid as raw materials is prepared. the polyelectrolyte compound hydrogel has a certain swelling rate and has the highest swelling rate, the largest ph value and the highest salt sensitivity and also the highest responsiveness to a physiological solution on the whole when the ratio of the chitosan solution to the polyacrylic acid solution is 6:4. therefore, the polyelectrolyte compound hydrogel is expected to be widely applied in the fields such as agriculture, food, tissue engineering, controlled release and the like.

column10: nonviral targeted nanoparticle system for gene transfer and drug delivery

column11: the invention discloses an efficient magnetic slow controlled release fertilizer capable of promoting the wheat photosynthesis. the fertilizer is prepared from loofah-sponge-based biomass fuel, a polymer magnetic material, desulfurated magnesium slag, mesoporous lithium iron phosphate, kieselguhr, rhizoma fagopyri dibotryis stem leaf powder, spiral seaweed powder, schizochytrium aggregatum powder, a bacillus subtilis culture, enzyme microorganism, choline chloride, multivitamins, ovolecithin, lysine, methionine, bile acid, chitosan oligosaccharide, glutathione, calcium gluconate, zanthoxylum oil, phosphogypsum, humic acid, konjac glucomannan, amino acid cross-linked aldehyde glucan hydrogel, nanometer magnetic fluid and the like. according to the fertilizer, the kieselguhr, the rhizoma fagopyri dibotryis stem leaf powder, the spiral seaweed powder and the schizochytrium aggregatum powder are coated with a coating material with the magnetic slow-release and promoted-release functions, and then a fermented granular fertilizer is prepared with the combination of a nutrient solution, and then the slow release fertilizer is prepared. through a magnetic adsorption effect, wheat is promoted to sprout, take root, grow and develop, and the wheat photosynthesis is promoted, the wheat yield is further improved, and efficient cultivation of the wheat is accelerated.

column10: degradable polymer core-shell microsphere loaded with protein drugs

column11: the invention provides a composition comprising a matrix of chitosan and a tannin wherein the chitosan is electrostatically bonded to the tannin to form a chitosan-tannin composite material. the chitosan can be partially or fully deacetylated, and the tannin can be a monomeric or an oligomeric proanthocyanidin or a hydrolysable tannin. the chitosan-tannin composite material can be a nanoparticle, a hydrogel film, a bio-foam, or a biogel, or the chitosan-tannin composite material can coat a liposome. the composite materials can be used for drug delivery, for antibacterial and/or antifungal applications, for tissue engineering applications, for wound healing applications, or they can be used as adjuvants for vaccination, including oral vaccinations. the invention also provides methods of preparing the composite materials and their various forms.

column10: preparation method of slow controlled release fertilizer for flowering peach
column11: the invention provides a preparation method of a slow controlled release fertilizer for flowering peach. the method includes the steps of adding urea, sodium citrate and humic acid to water, adjusting ph to 8.0-9.0, adding a formaldehyde solution, adding oxidized starch and hydrogenated vegetable oil, adjusting ph to 4.0-5.0, adjusting ph to 6.0-7.0 to obtain a mixture a, adding sodium alginate and gelatin to water, adding potassium nitrate, diammonium hydrogen phosphate, magnesium sulfate heptahydrate, vitamin b, nicotinamide, amino acid, corn flour, chitosan and lecithin to be mixed to obtain a mixture b, adding the mixture b to the mixture a to be dispersed, adding glutaraldehyde, raising the temperature to 45-55 deg c, keeping the temperature for 2-4 h, lowering the temperature to 0-5 deg c, and conducting filtering to obtain the slow controlled release fertilizer. the slow controlled release fertilizer can effectively increase the flowering number of flowering peach, is small in consumption, saves fertilizer applying cost, and improves the ornamental economic benefits of flowering peach.

column10: preparation method of chitosan-based composite nanoparticles for enzyme touch response controlled release doxorubicin hydrochloride
column11: the invention discloses a preparation technology of nanoparticles for delivering hydrophilic antitumor drugs, namely, a preparation method of chitosan-based composite nanoparticles for enzyme touch response controlled release doxorubicin hydrochloride. the method comprises the steps of firstly, mixing a chitosan-quercetin succinate-6-phosphogluconate solution and a doxorubicin hydrochloride solution, then carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the mixed solution, and dripping carboxymethyl chitosan into the mixed solution for carrying out polymer agglomeration to obtain chitosan-quercetin succinate-6-gphosphogluconate carboxymethyl chitosan composite nanoparticles for encapsulating doxorubicin hydrochloride, wherein the average particle size of the formed composite nanoparticles is 114-515nm, the electric potential of zeta is -27.4 to -7.9mv, and the encapsulation efficiency and the entrapment efficiency for the doxorubicin hydrochloride are respectively 71.45-93.32% and 14.1-20.2%. the product is capable of effectively reducing the cytotoxicity of the doxorubicin hydrochloride and increasing the cancer inhibition efficiency of the doxorubicin hydrochloride, remarkably improves the use safety and convenience of the doxorubicin hydrochloride, can be used as a medical biomaterial and a drug carrier, and has good research, development and application prospects.

column11: the invention discloses an organic acid sustained-release complex with functions of pest prevention and disease resistance, preparation and applications thereof, and belongs to the field of polymer modification and complexes. according to the present invention, a natural high-quality macromolecule material chitosan is modified to obtain tetraethylene pentamine chitosan having good water solubility, a natural pest-prevention and disease-resistance substance such as salicylic acid, abietic acid, caffeic acid and other organic acids is linked to the tetraethylene pentamine chitosan having good water solubility through a reflux reaction, and during the application, the organic acid is shed from the chitosan and is slowly released so as to achieve the long-lasting sustained-release pest-prevention and disease-resistance effect; and the obtained organic acid sustained-release complex has good performances of pest prevention and disease resistance, easily form the film, can be adhered onto the surface of crops or fruits to form the film, does not affect the plant growth, does not have toxic-side effect, can release the pest-prevention and disease-resistance substance in the long-lasting and sustained-release manner, can achieve the long-term pest-prevention and disease-resistance effect in the case of no pesticides, and can be used for production of green food.

column10: controlled release fertilizer containing strontium, and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses a controlled release fertilizer containing strontium. the controlled release fertilizer is prepared from, by weight, 85 to 100 parts of a coating material, 50 to 100 parts of urea, 45 to 80 parts of potassium sulfate, 40 to 60 parts of calcium superphosphate, 25 to 40 parts of ammonium hydrogen carbonate, 20 to 35 parts of a strontium source, 20 to 40 parts of waste residue, 15 to 25 parts of earthworm powder, 5 to 10 parts of chitosan, 5 to 10 parts of diatomite, and 0.5 to 3 parts of saccharomycetes. the invention also provides a preparation method of the controlled release fertilizer containing strontium. the controlled release fertilizer contains strontium, is capable of ensuring that crops are provided with abundant strontium in the whole growth process for absorption, and obtained crops are rich in strontium; and at the same time, utilization rate of the controlled release fertilizer is high, controlled release effect is moderate and stable, nutrient balance is achieved, fertilizer loss rate is reduced effectively, and crop yield is increased. operation of the preparation method is simple, and it is beneficial for popularization and application.

column10: constructing method for preparing nano target controlled release system from hyaluronic acid and chitosan modified graphene oxide
column11: the invention discloses a constructing method for preparing a nano target controlled release system from hyaluronic acid and chitosan modified graphene oxide. the method comprises the steps that a graphene oxide solution and a chitosan solution are mixed, then the mixed solution is mixed with a hyaluronic acid solution, then an hsp90 inhibitor is added, vacuum drying is carried out, and the nano target controlled release system is obtained. the transmission electron microscope, drug loading ratio, release rate, cytotoxicity and other performance of the formed nano target controlled release system are tested, and the result indicates that the system has good controlled release and target functions.

column10: enhanced targeted drug delivery system via chitosan hydrogel and chlorotoxin
column11: specific drug delivery to tumor cells without affecting normal cells is a major challenge in cancer treatment. the present invention incorporates embedding nonionic surfactant vesicles (niosomes) containing an anti-cancer therapeutic agent with chlorotoxin into a thermosensitive chitosan hydrogel network. chitosan has mucoadhesive property which can be used in the targeting of the tumor cells with the mucin over expression. chlorotoxin is a 36 amino acid peptide obtained from leiurus quinquestriatus scorpion venom which binds preferentially to tumor cells of neuroectodermal origin but not to normal cells. the incorporation of chlorotoxin along with niosomes in the chitosan hydrogel is used as the second targeting strategy to further improve the specific delivery of drugs to tumor cells such as glioma.

column10: chitosan nanofibres containing bioactive compounds
column11: the invention relates to self-assembled nanofibres of chitosan and bioactive compounds, which can be used as nutraceuticals or drugs. the bioactive compounds suitable for the nanofibres of the invention are molecules of a low molecular size with acid or lactone groups, aromatic rings and hydroxyls, such as small polyphenols and mixtures thereof. the nanofibres of the invention are absorbed, without degradation, at the level of the small intestine, containing and protecting the bioactive compounds until they reach the various target organs. the nanofibres also cross the blood-brain barrier, allowing the compounds to reach the brain where they act as a controlled release system. if the bioactive compounds are neuroprotectors, such as antioxidants, the nanofibres of the invention can be used to treat or prevent neurodegenerative diseases such as alzheimer's disease, parkinson's disease, huntington's disease and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (als), as well as she strokes and other diseases related to aging or associated with oxidative stress. the invention also relates to the method for obtaining the nanofibres, which comprises mixing chitosan with the bioactive compounds and allowing self-assembly. the invention further relates to the dosage form containing the nanofibres of the invention, particularly for oral administration, such as tablets, coated tablets, powders, capsules, syrups, or others.

column10: preparation method of nano-hydroxyapatite chitosan composite microsphere
column11: the invention relates to a preparation method of a nano-hydroxyapatite chitosan composite microsphere. the nano-hydroxyapatite chitosan composite microsphere is prepared from chitosan, calcium salt and phosphate by the following steps: adding the prepared phosphate/chitosan acetic acid solution into surfactant-containing liquid paraffin and stirring uniformly to form a water-in-oil emulsion; adding a cross-linking agent dropwise to perform cross linking; adding an alkaline solution to adjust ph, adding the calcium salt and stirring uniformly; and washing and drying to obtain the composite microsphere. the composite microsphere prepared by the method provided by the invention is round and uniform, and the nano-hydroxyapatite is distributed in and on the surface of the composite microsphere uniformly in a nanometer form. the method utilizes the high biocompatibility, the osteogenic activity and the biodegradability of the chitosan and the nano-hydroxyapatite to prepare the nano-composite microsphere, and has a potential application value in the aspects of minimally invasive treatment on bone tissue defect, orthopaedic beauty and medicine controlled release.

column10: pharmaceutical composition capable of enhancing intestinal absorption of tanshinol as well as preparation and preparation method of pharmaceutical composition

column10: selenium-supported chitosan microsphere controllably sustained-releasing selenium negative ions and preparation method thereof

column11: an object of the present invention is to provide a hydrogel capable of stably dispersing a large amount of volatile component and excellent in sustained release of volatile component. provided is a hydrogel comprising a porous resin particle and a volatile component, the porous resin particle having a pore diameter of 5 to 30 nm and an oil absorption of 50 to 700 ml/100 g, and a mass ratio between the volatile component (a) and the porous resin particle (b) contained in the hydrogel being (a):(b)=1:1 to 1:4.

column10: drug conjugated nanogels in microcapsule for delayed sustained protein delivery
column11: injectable compositions and use of the injectable compositions in tissue engineering applications are described. the injectable compositions are hydrogel-based compositions that can be crosslinked in situ following placement. the injectable compositions include microcapsules having predetermined erosion profiles that are loaded with nanogels having predetermined sustained release profiles for signaling molecules conjugated to the nanogels. following crosslinking, the compositions are designed to sequentially release signaling molecules over a predetermined period of time with various release profiles. the compositions can carry additional components to stimulate tissue generation such as stem cells and extracellular matrix (ecm) components.

column10: epigallocatechin-3-gallate loaded guanosine borate hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column11: the invention relates to the field of biomedical materials, in particular to catechin loaded guanosine borate hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. the preparation method comprises the following steps: putting guanosine and koh into a round-bottom flask, adding deionized water, heating and stirring until guanosine is completely dissolved; then adding boric acid and epigallocatechin-3-gallate (egcg), continuously heating and stirring until the reaction is completed, and cooling to room temperature, so as to prepare the egcg loaded guanosine borate hydrogel. according to the hydrogel disclosed by the invention, guanosine is self-assembled to form a g-quadrubplex network, and boric acid ester bonds are introduced to strengthen crosslinking, so that the stability and the mechanical strength of the gel are improved. ph/ros dual response is achieved, and precise controlled release is achieved; the epigallocatechin-3-gallate is stably loaded, so that the stability of the epigallocatechin-3-gallate is improved, the bioavailability is increased, the biocompatibility is good, and the epigallocatechin-3-gallate is free from tissue toxicity; angiogenesis is promoted, and diabetes wound healing is accelerated.

column11: the present invention provides a silk fibroin-based hydrogel and antibiotic composition comprising 5% silk fibroin embedded with 0.4-2% antibiotic, more particularly tetracycline or doxycycline, the antibiotic used to prepare the silk fibroin-based hydrogel being a supersaturated solution, i.e. 100% antibiotic in deionized water. the invention also provides a method for preparing the hydrogel and antibiotic composition based on the silk fibroin. the method comprises the following steps: preparing a 5% silk fibroin solution and keeping the temperature at 16-21 deg c; adding a saturated antibiotic solution to the silk fibroin solution to form a silk fibroin-based hydrogel; stabilizing the hydrogel at 16 to 21 deg c; and lyophilizing the stable hydrogel at 4-6 deg c to form a dry hydrogel silk fibroin matrix having a drug embedded therein. in addition, the present invention provides compositions of drug-silk fibroin-based hydrogel formulations and methods for their use in wound healing of extraction fossa.

column10: exploiting oxygen inhibited photopolymerization within emulsion droplets for the fabrication of microparticles with customizable size, shape and interfacial and mechanical properties
column11: described are methods and devices for the generation of hydrogel particles with micrometer and submicrometer dimensions using oxygen-inhibited partial polymerization, and the particles generated therefrom. the described methods generate particles with dimensions independent of the starting polymerizable solution dimension, for example, a microdroplet. further, microfluidic flow parameters (e.g. viscosity, flow rate) and photopolymerization process parameters (e.g. optical exposure intensity and duration) are controlled to generate particles with tunable crosslinking density-determined properties including elasticity, diffusivity, and biomolecular display for diverse applications such as drug delivery, tissue engineering cell scaffolds, and single- and multiple-cell therapeutics. similarly, gradients of crosslinking density-determined properties can be created within single particles through the selection of optical exposure intensity and duration. in addition to conventional spherical shapes, a suite of non-spherical shapes may be generated by manipulating the dimensions of the microfluidic channels and other related physical and process parameters.

column10: photo-thermal response type insect sex pheromone sustained release preparation and application thereof
column11: the invention discloses a photo-thermal response type insect sex pheromone sustained release preparation and application. the preparation is prepared from 54.55 wt% to 59.41 wt% of thermal response hydrogel, 0.99 wt% to 9.09 wt% of copper-polyphenol nano particles and 36.36 wt% to 39.6 wt% of insect sex pheromone emulsion. mixing the insect sex pheromone emulsion, the copper-phenol nanoparticles and the thermal response hydrogel, fully stirring for 30 minutes to ensure that the insect sex pheromone is uniformly distributed in the thermal response hydrogel solution, and cooling at the temperature of 30 deg c or below to prepare hydrogel, so as to obtain the photo-thermal response type insect sex pheromone sustained release preparation. the release rate of the insect sex pheromone is cooperatively controlled through the photothermal conversion effect of the copper-polyphenol nanoparticles and the temperature response of the thermal response hydrogel. the release speed of the insect sex pheromone can be controlled by controlling different illumination intensities, illumination time and temperature conditions, and the lasting period of the insect sex pheromone is remarkably prolonged.

column10: temperature response type cycloxaprid controlled release system and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention provides a temperature response type cycloxaprid controlled release system and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of alkali insecticides. the temperature response type cycloxaprid controlled release system provided by the invention comprises a poly (n-isopropylacrylamide) temperature-sensitive hydrogel and a polyurethane-cycloxaprid oil-in-water microcapsule, wherein the poly (n-isopropylacrylamide) hydrogel and the polyurethane-cycloxaprid oil-in-water microcapsule form a semi-interpenetrating network structure. according to the invention, polyurethane and poly (n-isopropylacrylamide) temperature-sensitive (pnipaam) hydrogel are utilized to form a semi-interpenetrating network structure, so that the low critical transition temperature of a controlled release system is reduced, and the controlled release system has good thermal stability and temperature-sensitive characteristics. according to data of an embodiment, the temperature response type cycloxaprid controlled release system obtained by the invention has good drug release performance and good stability in an environment of 20-31 deg c.

column10: iontophoresis dosing device
column11: the invention belongs to the technical field of medical auxiliary instruments, and relates to an iontophoresis dosing device which comprises a ring body, the ring body comprises a first shell, a second shell and two connecting pieces of the same structure, and the two connecting pieces are located on the two sides of the first shell correspondingly to achieve connection of the first shell and the second shell; the first treatment assembly comprises a first hydrogel patch, a second hydrogel patch and a constant current source circuit system, the first hydrogel patch is arranged on the concave surface of the first shell, the second hydrogel patch is arranged on the concave surface of the second shell, and the constant current source circuit system is arranged on the second shell and electrically connected with the first hydrogel patch and the second hydrogel patch; an electric field perpendicular to eyes is formed, so that gaps of cornea and sclera are changed to form a water channel with a fixed direction, and medicine enters the deep positions of the eyes along the water channel. the device is small in size, convenient to operate, capable of being used at home and low in economic cost, and the transdermal drug delivery efficiency and stability are improved.

column11: the invention discloses functional injection type bionic hydrogel for promoting bone healing and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of medical instruments. the hydrogel has good functional characteristics, is a biomimetic material prepared on the basis of methacrylated gelatin, and aims to regulate and control the degradation rate, the drug release mechanism and diversified synergistic treatment and promote bone repair and regeneration; according to the hydrogel, matching of the degradation rate and the bone regeneration rate is achieved through reasonable matching, stem cell osteogenic differentiation and angiogenesis are promoted, ultrasonic controlled-release drug release and synergistic controlled-release of active factors are achieved, inflammation is reduced, and the bone repair process is promoted; the calcium phosphate bone cement provides biocompatibility and bone conductivity, and the nano clay releases active ions to improve the microenvironment and promote bone repair; in addition, the magnetic nanoparticles and a static magnetic field have synergistic interaction, the bone healing process is further accelerated, and treatment effect monitoring is enhanced through magnetic resonance imaging.

column10: controlled release type bio-organic fertilizer and production process thereof
column11: the invention belongs to the technical field of bio-organic fertilizers, and particularly relates to a controlled release type bio-organic fertilizer and a production process thereof. the biological base fertilizer is prepared by fermenting and treating organic wastes such as crop straws, livestock and poultry manure and the like, the controlled-release microelement fertilizer adopts a ph-sensitive hydrogel polymeric embedding material to realize controlled release of embedded nutrient substances, and the controlled-release microbe is a multifunctional composite flora; mixing the prepared biological base fertilizer, controlled-release microelement fertilizer and controlled-release microorganisms to obtain a mixture; preparing the mixture into granules; and carrying out drying treatment on the granulated fertilizer. compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects: process innovation is carried out on a nutrient substance controlled release method and a special microorganism adding mode, the produced controlled release type bio-organic fertilizer has the soil improvement effect of an organic fertilizer and the quick-acting fertilizer supply effect of an inorganic fertilizer, and meanwhile, continuous supply of nutrients is realized through a controlled release technology; the fertilizer utilization rate is improved, and the environmental pollution is reduced.

column10: method for preparing hydrogel based on molecules containing single boric acid groups and application

column10: method for preparing carboxymethylated xanthan gum-sulfated xanthan gum-methacrylated gelatin hydrogel scaffold
column11: the invention discloses a method for preparing a carboxymethylated xanthan gum-sulfated xanthan gum-methacrylated gelatin hydrogel scaffold, and belongs to the technical field of natural high polymer materials. the preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively reacting xanthan gum with chloroacetic acid and chlorosulfonic acid, purifying to obtain carboxymethylated xanthan gum and sulfated xanthan gum, reacting gelatin with methacrylic anhydride, purifying to obtain methylacryloylated gelatin, and drying to obtain the methylacryloylated gelatin. and dissolving the obtained carboxymethylated xanthan gum, sulfated xanthan gum and methacrylated gelatin in deionized water, and carrying out optical radiation crosslinking for 10-600 seconds by using a 0.05 wt%-1 wt% phenyl-2, 4, 6-trimethylbenzoyl lithium phosphinate aqueous solution photoinitiator, so as to obtain the carboxymethylated xanthan gum-sulfated xanthan gum-methacrylated gelatin hydrogel scaffold. the used raw materials are rich in source, the used photoinitiator is low in toxicity, good in water solubility and efficient, and the prepared stent material can be biomimetic mineralized, can controllably release embedded drugs, and is good in mechanical property and good in biocompatibility. the carboxymethylated xanthan gum-sulfated xanthan gum-methacrylated gelatin hydrogel can be used for preparing bone tissue repair materials, 3d printing artificial tissue scaffolds, biomedical materials and drug controlled release carriers.

column10: melphalan gel based on ultrasonic response as well as preparation method and application of melphalan gel
column11: the invention discloses melphalan gel based on ultrasonic response as well as a preparation method and application of the melphalan gel. according to the preparation method disclosed by the invention, the melphalan hydrogel with a cross-linked nanofiber structure is rapidly formed by the melphalan under the ultrasonic action through non-covalent interaction. melphalan hydrogels can be used to improve traditional haic treatment methods for liver cancer, including expediting catheter removal, reducing systemic toxicity, increasing local drug concentration, and prolonging drug-cell interaction time. in a rat model, the melphalan hydrogel-assisted haic shows better effectiveness than the traditional haic, can significantly inhibit the growth of liver cancer, activates effective anti-tumor immune response, and realizes complete cure in part of liver cancer. in addition, the drug delivery capability of the melphalan hydrogel is expected to improve the pharmacokinetic characteristics of various drugs and promote the synergistic treatment effect of various drugs. therefore, the invention provides a choice capable of obviously optimizing the treatment process and improving the overall treatment result for liver cancer treatment.

column10: formula optimization and preparation method of composite gel for sodium fluoride drug sustained release
column11: the invention provides a formula optimization and preparation method of a composite gel for sodium fluoride drug sustained release, and belongs to the technical field of composite gels for sodium fluoride drug sustained release, and the formula optimization method comprises the following steps: designing a plurality of groups of initial formulas based on literatures and preparatory experiments, the influence of the graphene oxide, the monomer, the cross-linking agent and other components on the slow-release gel performance is emphatically investigated. main formula parameters are determined through a principal component analysis method, and a second-order polynomial model is established to optimize performance indexes. a deep neural network model is adopted to perform virtual screening in a wider parameter space, and candidate formulas are selected in combination with an analytic hierarchy process and a topsis method. the preparation method comprises the following steps: uniformly dispersing graphene oxide in deionized water, adding acrylic acid and acrylamide monomers, performing ultrasonic dispersion, degassing, adding a cross-linking agent and an initiator, heating in a water bath to obtain polyacrylamide composite hydrogel, and soaking the polyacrylamide composite hydrogel in a sodium fluoride solution to obtain the composite hydrogel loaded with the sodium fluoride medicine.

column10: adhesive hydrogel drug-loaded microsphere for acupoint stimulation, and preparation method and application thereof
column11: the invention provides an adhesive hydrogel drug-loaded microsphere for acupoint stimulation as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of medicines. comprising the following steps: s1, weighing phosphatidylserine and cholesterol powder, dissolving the phosphatidylserine and cholesterol powder in trichloromethane, and performing rotary evaporation to remove a solvent until the phosphatidylserine and cholesterol powder is dried to form a lipid film; s2, pouring a pbs (phosphate buffer solution) added with adenosine into the lipid film, and hydrating to form a liposome solution; s3, preparing mineral oil and a ge ma solution, uniformly mixing the liposome solution with the ge ma solution, and adding a photoinitiator to obtain a mixed solution; s4, the mixed solution is subjected to a photo-crosslinking reaction under the condition of ultraviolet lamp irradiation, and hydrogel drug-loaded microspheres are formed; and s5, adding the hydrogel drug-loaded microspheres into a dopamine solution, and forming a polydopamine coating on the surfaces of the microspheres. according to the invention, the free adenosine is embedded in the hydrogel microspheres with adhesion to acupuncture points, so that the sustained release of the adenosine can be realized, the problem of short half-life period of the adenosine can be overcome, and the lasting time of the drug effect can be prolonged.

column10: nanolipogel vehicles for controlled delivery of different pharmaceutical agents
column11: a “nanolipogel” is a delivery vehicle including one or more lipid layer surrounding a hydrogel core, which may include an absorbent such as a cyclodextrin or ion-exchange resin. nanolipogels can be constructed so as to incorporate a variety of different chemical entities that can subsequently be released in a controlled fashion. these different incorporated chemical entities can differ dramatically with respect to size and composition. nanolipogels have been constructed to contain co-encapsulated proteins as well as small hydrophobic drugs within the interior of the lipid bilayer. agents incorporated within nanolipogels can be released into the milieu in a controlled fashion, for example, nanolipogels provide a means of achieving simultaneous sustained release of agents that differ widely in chemical composition and molecular weight. additionally, nanolipogels can favorably modulate biodistribution.

column10: ultra-high throughput on-chip synthesis of microgels with tunable mechanical properties
column11: hydrogel particles (microgels) generated using microfluidic methods have superb properties such as high size uniformity and precise control over degradation and release profiles, making them useful for applications in wound healing and injectable drug delivery. however, the throughput of microfluidics is constrained by the physics governing the flow of immiscible fluids confined within microchannels. this throughput tends to be several orders of magnitude lower than what would be necessary for commercial and clinical applications. here, we demonstrate the scaling up of on-chip synthesis of microgels by parallelizing the microfluidic channels. taking advantage of the established fabrication technologies developed by the semiconductor industry and a high flow control system, a 4-inch silicon microfluidic chip integrating more than 4,000 microfluidic devices is developed. by incorporating a high energy flood uv source, this chip allows the synthesis of poly (ethylene glycol) diacrylate microgel particles with diameter down to 30 m at a throughput above ikg/hr. by using photomasks that enable milli-second scale control of the uv exposure, the stiffness of microgels can be varied.
