column11: the present invention relates to anisotropic bimetal-polymer hybrid nanostructures, that is, self-assembled bimetal-polymer janus nanostructures, self-assembled nanostructures thereof, a fabrication method thereof, a metal nanoprobe using the same, a drug carrier, and a surface-enhanced raman scattering (sers)-based detection method for a target material. the bimetal-polymer janus nanostructures according to the present invention are composed of bimetal nano-cluster blocks, which are induced for selective functionalization through a covalent bond with oda, and conductive polymer blocks; and as controlled self-assembled bodies thereof are formed, sers intensity was significantly enhanced. accordingly, the janus nanostructures of the present invention may be used as a metal nanoprobe for sers-based, or fluorescence-based biosensing and/or bioimaging measurement for target material detection. the bimetal-polymer janus nanostructures and self-assembled janus nanostructure clusters thereof according to the present invention, by comprising the positively-charged conductive polymer block, can load a drug within the polymer block through an electrostatic interaction with a negatively-charged drug; can form a hydrogel containing concentrated drug-loaded nanoparticles; and can be induced to release the drug through altering voltage or ph conditions, and thus can be used as a drug carrier whose drug release can be controlled.

column10: encapsulation-free controlled protein release system
column11: the present disclosure provides a delivery system for controlled protein release without encapsulation. identical, burst-free, extended release profiles for three different protein therapeutics were obtained with and without encapsulation in plga nanoparticles embedded within a hydrogel. using both positively and negatively charged proteins, it was shown that short-range electrostatic interactions between the proteins and the plga nanoparticles are the underlying mechanism for controlled release. moreover, tunable release was demonstrated by modifying nanoparticle concentration, nanoparticle size, or environmental ph. additionally, the utility of this system was demonstrated in vivo for bdnf delivery in a rat model of stroke. these new insights obviate the need for encapsulation and offer promising, translatable strategies for more effective delivery of therapeutic biomolecules.

column10: crosslinked sodium alginate hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column11: the invention relates to the field of sustained release of pesticides, and discloses crosslinked sodium alginate hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. according to the preparation method, sodium alginate and polyacrylamide are taken as main raw materials, and the crosslinked sodium alginate hydrogel is prepared by compounding na-montmorillonite. the invention also discloses the preparation method of the crosslinked sodium alginate hydrogel and the application of the crosslinked sodium alginate hydrogel in the sustained release of the pesticides. the crosslinked sodium alginate hydrogel prepared by the method provided by the invention has a reticular structure; the na-montmorillonite is distributed in the reticular structure of gel in a lamellar structure and interacts with a polymer chain of the gel, so that the swelling action of the gel in water is limited; furthermore, under the compound effect of the na-montmorillonite, the reticular structure of the gelis enabled to be more complicated, and the outward diffusion of drugs in the reticular structure of the gel is diminished, so that the sustained release effect is enhanced.

column10: dna (desoxyribonucleic acid) fluorescent hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses dna (desoxyribonucleic acid) fluorescent hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. the preparation method comprises steps as follows: (1) dna hydrogel is prepared; (2) the dnahydrogel is put in sterile water, water is changed once every 15-30 min, and water is changed 3-5 times in total; (3) the dna hydrogel obtained in the step (2) is added to a phosphate buffer and an agno3 water solution for a reaction; a nabh4 water solution is added, the mixture reacts, and the dna fluorescent hydrogel is obtained. the dna fluorescent hydrogel has good biocompatibility and material softness, can effectively avoid secondary injury of wound as medical dressing and can relieve pain of the wound; the hydrogel has fluorescence and has certain antibacterial property and no cytotoxicity. the hydrogel preparation process is simple and convenient. the hydrogel can be applied to the field of medical dressing, immunotherapy, tissue engineering, monocellular culture, drug sustained release, protein synthesis, biosensors and the like.

column10: pentablock polypeptidic and hybrid polymers to give in situ-forming injectable, self-healing, ph-and temperature-responsive hydrogels for localised targeted delivery of gemcitabine
column11: i abstract the invention relates: a. the synthesis of new polymeric materials, b. the polymeric materials form hydrogels with unique properties: is self-healable and thus becomes injectable, and additionally is responsive to ph and temperature. c. the polymeric materials form a mixture suitable for targeted delivery of gemcitabine to pancreatic cancer in solid tissue form. the composition consists of the polymeric materials, water and gemcitabine, forming strong hydrogels and transfers gemcitabine selectively to local pancreatic cancer tissue. two polymeric materials are presented. one is a pentablock tripolymer of poly(l-lysine) and poly(l-histidine-co-y-benzyl l-glutamate), while the other one is a hybrid tetrapolymer containing poly(ethylene oxide), poly(l-lysine) and poly(l-histidine-co-v-benzyl l-glutamate). the polymeric materials are injectable, in-situ forming and rapidly self-healing, they are not cytotoxic up to 400 mg/kg after in vivo studies in mice, according to the national cancer institute of usa. the composition responds to temperature and ph through a conversion from liquid to solid and a transformation of the secondary structure of the polymeric material. this multifunctionality allows the mixture to be placed near and in contact with the cancer tissue with the simplest possible application, i.e. via injection with a very thin needle. furthermore, due to ph- and temperature-responsiveness, the mixtures melt and convert to liquids near the cancer tissue and thus are absorbed selectively by it, while they remain strong hydrogels at the healthy tissue, blocking release of the drug. in this way, the release of the drug is directed only to the cancer tissue. our invention is unique and operates differently from other ph- and temperature-responsive hydrogel systems where the conversion from viscous liquid to hydrogel is effected in situ due to the lower ph and the higher temperature of the cancer tissues. our composition is converted in situ from hydrogel to liquid due to conversion of the secondary structure, independently from the ph and temperature, and then melts selectively only towards the cancer tissue due to the lower ph and the higher temperature, delivering and releasing the drug in a targeted and time-controlled manner.

column10: whey protein isolate hydrogels and their uses
column11: a biodegradable hydrogel has been made based on high concentrations of whey protein isolate (wpi). wpi gels of different compositions were fabricated by thermally inducing gelation of high-concentration suspensions of protein, and characterized for compressive strength and modulus, hydration swelling and drying properties, mechanical behavior change due to polysaccharide additives, and intrinsic pore network structure. the gels were shown to be compatible with bone cells and could be used as bone tissue scaffolds. in addition, wpi fibers were produced by electrospinning. several additives could be incorporated into the wpi gels, including structural additives, growth factors, amino acids, etc. the wpi hydrogels can be made with glycerol to increase flexibility and stability. the hydrogels could be used for tissue regeneration, food protection, controlled-release applications (including drug encapsulation, dietary supplement release, attractant release in lures, nutrient release to plants (fertilizers), column packing for compound separation, and membrane development.

column10: method for preparing dual-network hydrogel capable of orthogonally regulating mechanical property and drug release property
column11: the invention discloses a method for preparing dual-network hydrogel capable of orthogonally regulating the mechanical property and the drug release property through photo-crosslinking. the method includes the steps that firstly, polyacrylic acid and monoamino beta cyclodextrin serve as reactants to prepare polyacrylic acid powder grafted with beta cyclodextrin; secondly, the polyacrylic acid powder grafted with beta cyclodextrin is dissolved in a phosphoric acid buffer solution, and acrylamide, n'n-methylene bisacrylamide and a photoinitiator are added, and after the materials are uniformly stirred and mixed, cross-linking is conducted under ultraviolet. the method is simple in process, short in preparation period, controllable in size, high in repeatability and good in stability. the mechanical property of the prepared double-network hydrogel and the release property to polypeptides and other drugs can be orthogonally regulated and do not interfere with each other. the one-weight network controls the mechanical strength by adjusting a polymer network, and the one-weight network regulates controlled release by adjusting the affinity with drug molecules. the double-network hydrogel has a wide application prospect in the aspects of biological medicine, tissue engineering and the like.

column10: preparation method of deformation controllable hydrogel actuator
column11: the invention provides a deformation controllable hydrogel actuator and a preparation method thereof. the deformation controllable hydrogel actuator is prepared from an inorganic nano-material, poly(isopropyl acrylamide) and water, wherein the concentration distribution of the inorganic nano-material in a thickness direction is non-uniform, so as to form an asymmetrical heterojunction structure; in a plane direction, the non-uniform asymmetrical structure can be randomly patterned according to requirements, so that various reversible deformation triggered by temperature is realized. the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing isopropyl acrylamide monomer, an initiator and the inorganic nano-material to form uniform pre-gel; pouring the pre-gel into a rectangular mold; covering one layer of mask plate on the pre-gel; evaporating partial water to induce the concentration of the inorganic nano-material to be not uniformly distributed in the thickness direction of an exposed region; then carrying out in-situ polymerization to fix a patterned non-uniform structure, so as to form the deformation controllable hydrogel actuator. the method is simple and feasible and easy to realize; the deformation controllable hydrogel actuator can be used for soft robots, drug delivery, microfluidic valves and artificial muscle.

column10: collagen/chondroitin sulfate composite artificial cornea and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of a collagen/chondroitin sulfate composite artificial cornea. the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving collagen into a water solution of imidazole ionic liquid to obtain a collagen solution (1-30%); then dissolving chondroitin sulfate into a water solution to obtain a chondroitin sulfate water solution (1-20 mg/ml); evenly mixing two solutions according to a certain ratio, adding a natural crosslinking agent (edc/nhs) with a good biocompatibility to prepare collagen/chondroitin sulfate in-situ crosslinked composite hydrogel; soaking the composite hydrogel in a coagulating bath to carry out moulding and regeneration, washing the hydrogel by water to remove the solvent, naturally drying to obtain a collagen/chondroitin sulfate composite membrane; dissolving a corneal growth factor fgf-10 into a phosphoric acid buffer solution to obtain a fgf-10 water solution (1-100 [mu]g/ml) ; and soaking the composite membrane into the fgf-10 water solution to prepare a collagen based membrane col/cs/fgf with a sustained release effect. the provided novel artificial cornea has the advantages of high strength, sustained release, and biocompatibility, and has an important application prospect.

column10: cytidine-based supermolecular hydrogel and preparation method and application thereof

column10: snail bionic viscous hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column11: snail bionic viscous hydrogel and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of polymer hydrogel. inspired by snail capable of crawling on different surfaces by mucus, allantoin which is one of main components in mucus is used as a raw material. the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly carrying out acryloyl chloride modification on the raw material, carrying out precipitation with ether to modify the allantoin monomer, carrying out suction filtration by a buchner funnel, transferring to a vacuum oven and drying, adding the modified allantoin monomer and a hydrophilic monomer acrylamide and an initiator potassium persulphate into deionized water, stirring under water-bath condition until materials are completely dissolved, directly placing the prepared solution into a mould, placing the die into the oven and carrying out a heating reaction, and carrying out free radical polymerization on the modified allantoin monomer and the hydrophilic monomer so as to form high-molecular polymer hydrogel. allantoin has good biocompatibility and has no toxicity. raw materials are easily available, and cost is low. the prepared hydrogel has viscosity and can be used in fields of controlled release of drug, drug dressing, etc.

column10: nanolipogel vehicles for controlled delivery of different pharmaceutical agents
column11: a “nanolipogel” is a delivery vehicle including one or more lipid layer surrounding a hydrogel core, which may include an absorbent such as a cyclodextrin or ion-exchange resin. nanolipogels can be constructed so as to incorporate a variety of different chemical entities that can subsequently be released in a controlled fashion. these different incorporated chemical entities can differ dramatically with respect to size and composition. nanolipogels have been constructed to contain co-encapsulated proteins as well as small hydrophobic drugs within the interior of the lipid bilayer. agents incorporated within nanolipogels can be released into the milieu in a controlled fashion, for example, nanolipogels provide a means of achieving simultaneous sustained release of agents that differ widely in chemical composition and molecular weight. additionally, nanolipogels can favorably modulate biodistribution.

column10: system and method for delivery of a protease inhibitor
column11: the disclosed invention provides a system and method of artificially retarding fibrin-based blood clot degradation via the sustained release of a protease inhibitor, such as, for example, aprotinin or tranexamic acid (“ta”). the sustained release of the protease inhibitor is accomplished through incorporation within a biodegradable polymer microsphere to produce a protease inhibitor formulation. next, the formulation along with fibrinogen and thrombin is applied to a wound site where an outer surface of the polymer microsphere degrades in a proteolytic environment to expose and release the incorporated protease inhibitor to the surrounding hydrogel or sealant or clot matrix at the wound site.

column10: pirfenidone pva (polyvinyl alcohol) hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of pirfenidone pva (polyvinyl alcohol) hydrogel. the preparation method includes the steps of dissolving pirfenidone in ethyl alcohol to form a saturated solution, and mixing the pirfenidone-ethyl alcohol solution with a 20% (by mass) polyvinyl alcohol water solution to obtain mixed liquid; pouring the mixed liquid into a round mould, and freezing the mould in a precise-temperature-control cold trap refrigerator for forming for 6 hours at the temperature of minus 30-minus 15 deg c; taking out the mould, melting the mixed liquid at the room temperature for two hours, and repeating freezing and melting for 2-5 times to obtain the pirfenidone pva hydrogel. the invention further discloses the pirfenidone pva hydrogel. by the pirfenidone pva hydrogel, the effects of burst release and controlled release can be achieved, and medicinal toxic and side effects caused by ultrahigh plasma concentration can be avoided.

column10: preparation method of electrical stimulation-near infrared dual response high strength hydrogel

column11: the invention belongs to the technical field of composite materials and discloses nano-composite hydrogel based on carboxymethyl xylan and preparation and application thereof. according to the preparation method, graphite oxide powder is added into deionized water, and ultrasonic dispersion is performed to obtain go aqueous dispersion liquid; an acrylamide monomer and the carboxymethyl xylan are added into the go aqueous dispersion liquid, the mixture is stirred and dispersed to be uniform, an initiator, a cross-linking agent and an accelerant are added on an ice-bath condition, and the mixture is stirred and mixed to be uniform to obtain a mixed solution; the mixed solution is dried and reacts at the temperature of 50-80 deg c for 2-6 h to obtain hydrogel; lastly, the hydrogel is soaked in an al(no3)3 solution for cross-linking to obtain the nano-composite hydrogel based on the carboxymethyl xylan. the composite hydrogel has high mechanical performance, is biodegradable, has good biocompatibility and can be applied to biomedical fields such as tissue engineering, drug sustained release, cell culture stents and cartilage tissue.

column10: thermally induced hydrogel containing selenium or tellurium, and preparation method and applications thereof
column11: the invention belongs to the field of biomedical polymer materials, and specifically relates to a thermally induced hydrogel containing selenium or tellurium, and a preparation method and applications thereof. the thermally induced hydrogel is composed of an amphiphilic block copolymer containing selenium or tellurium and a solvent; thermally induced gelatinization phase transformation of a water system of the amphiphilic block copolymer and the solvent can be realized with temperature increasing so as to realize spontaneous formation of a physical hydrogel, wherein the amphiphilic block copolymer containing selenium or tellurium is obtained via covalent bonding of small molecules containing selenium or tellurium with an amphiphilic block copolymer. long-acting platinum drug gel sustained-release preparations can be obtained via coordination of the thermally induced hydrogel with platinum drugs. the long-acting platinum drug gel sustained-release preparations are capable of prolonging and adjusting release behavior of the loaded platinum antitumor drugs. drug administration of the long-acting platinum drug gel sustained-release preparations in tumor, around tumor, or in tumor cavity can be realized via injection; in situ formation of gel is realized at body temperature, and the platinum drugs loaded via coordination bonds can be released from the gel slowly, so that administration frequency is reduced, and drug whole body toxicity is reduced. the long-acting platinum drug gel sustained-release preparations can be applied to tumor treatment at different periods.

column10: dressing compositions and methods
column11: described is a spray-on hydrogel comprising water-soluble peg polymers that cross-link in situ to form a hydrogel such that the cross-links are reversible. the hydrogel can be useful as a drug delivery composition, wound dressing or surgery adjuvant. polyethylene glycol polymer and cross-linker solutions are sprayed simultaneously through a common orifice. cross-linking via formation of thioether or disulfide bonds is initiated upon mixing, providing rapid gelation. the hydrogel components can be derivatized with rgd peptides or analogs thereof to promote retention in/on a body compartment such as the skin, surface of the eye, or a mucosa such as the vaginal mucosa. the cross-links are reversed using a reducing solution enabling easy removal of the hydrogel by dissolution. processes for preparation of the cross-linker, rgd derivatized peg and rgd-linked agents are also disclosed.

column10: nitric oxide delivery system using thermosensitive synthetic polymers
column11: a donor capable of controlled release of nitric monoxide and a prosthetic implant whose surface is coated with this donor are disclosed. the donor comprises a main chain of an organic polymer and a side chain that is covalently linked to the main chain and has a diazeniumdiolate functional group. the donor for controlled release of nitric monoxide exists in a fluid state such as liquid at room temperature and undergoes a sol-to-gel phase transition at a physiological ph as the temperature increases above the critical temperature. the critical temperature of the phase transition is in the range of 25 to 35° c., and the gel is a hydrogel without chemical cross-links.

column10: multifunctional face mask
column11: the present invention relates to a mask sheet in which a conduit ventilation path coated with an adhesive is zigzag or spirally installed, and is a mask in which atmosphere air entrance holes and atmosphere air breathing holes are perforated on both ends of the ventilation path such that dust contained in the air coming into from the air entrance holes and passing through the air breathing holes are attached on the adhesive coated on the conduit ventilation path and removed. the mask sheet according to the present invention is composed of a pair of an atmosphere exposure polymer sheet and a face directional sheet, and each of the pair of sheets having mutual symmetric recesses with a shape selected from a concave shape, a rectangle, a circle and a polygon, and wrapping a face shape adaptive soft sheet around a core sheet having the conduit ventilation path formed by matching and adhering protruding recess portion with non-protruding portion of the pair of sheets. the mask sheet according to the present invention coats the adhesive to the face shape adaptive soft sheet to be worn without ear hooks. the adhesive may not contain antimicrobial and may be an antimicrobial adhesive for preventing infiltration of bacteria. the mask according to the present invention contains a volatile therapeutic agent in the adhesive coated on the ventilation path or contains porous powder having the volatile therapeutic agent in the adhesive to function as a sustained release inhalation therapeutic agent. the mask according to the present invention coats antimicrobial hydrogel on the ventilation path to provide moisture to a patient needing wet air.

column10: peptide hydrogel properties and its applications
column11: peptide hydrogels having a self-assembling, 3-dimensional nanofiber matrix are described. the nanofiber matrix comprises an amphiphilic peptide and optionally albumin. the peptide comprises (consists of) a terminal hydrophobic region, a central turning region, and a terminal hydrophilic region. methods of making such hydrogels are also described, along with methods of using the hydrogels as scaffolding for tissue engineering, hemostatic agents, as well as 3-dimensional cell cultures, and for drug delivery, encapsulation of active agents (therapeutic cells, molecules, drugs, compounds), cell transplantation, cell storage, virus culture and storage.

column10: non-radical photochemical crosslinked hydrogel material preparation method, product and application
column11: the present invention provides a non-radical photo-crosslinked hydrogel preparation method, comprising the following steps: a component a is dissolved in a biocompatible medium to obtain a solution a, component b-hydrazide, hydroxylamine or primary amine high molecular derivative is dissolved in a biocompatible medium to obtain a solution b; the solution a and the solution b are evenly mixed to obtain a hydrogel precursor solution; under illumination, aldehyde group produced by light excitation of o-nitrobenzyl in the component a of the hydrogel precursor solution is crosslinked with hydrazone, hydroxylamine or primary amine group in the component b in the form of respective formation of oxime and schiff base to produce the hydrogel. the present invention also provides a kit for the hydrogel preparation, and application of the hydrogel in tissue repair, beauty and as a cell, protein or drug carrier. the tissue surface light-situ gel can be achieved by the hydrogel, in particular, wound surface in-situ thin glue formation can be achieved, and the hydrogel is especially suitable for clinical wound surface tissue repair and isolation.

column11: the invention relates to a time-temperature double-sensitive degradable polymer hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. the time-temperature double-sensitive degradable polymer hydrogel is mainly composed of a degradable polymer and a medium; the degradable polymer is a triblock multipolymer, and is prepared via steps of material preparation, polymerization, refining, sol preparation, and gelatinization; the time-temperature double-sensitive degradable polymer hydrogel based on the degradable polymer has time and temperature double sensitivity because of a unique structure and a synthetic method, and is extremely suitable for injection; syringe needle blocking is not caused in injection processes; after injection, it is beneficial for free and full distribution of drug-containing hydrogel in infection cavities in the body, and is beneficial for improving adaptive capacity of the hydrogel on body local characteristics, so that drug controlled release effect and disease treatment effect are improved. the time-temperature double-sensitive degradable polymer hydrogel is suitable to be taken as a controlled release carrier of drugs, dna, cells, functional nanoparticles, and tissue chips, and is capable of satisfying requirements on diagnosis, treatment, and health care in the field of biomedicine.

column10: preparation method for high-strength hydrogel with rapid response to both ph value and temperature
column11: the invention relates to a preparation method for a high-strength dual-network hydrogel capable of rapidly responding to both a ph value and temperature. the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dissolving temperature-sensitive monomer, ph-sensitive monomer and inorganic cross-linking agent modified nanometer clay in water together, placing the obtained solution in a container, carrying out stirring in an ice bath with a temperature of 0 deg for 60 min under the protection of nitrogen until the solution is uniform and transparent, then adding an aqueous solution of a silica network precursor and continuing stirring for 30 min until the obtained mixture is uniform and transparent; (2) adding an aqueous solution of a redox initiator and a catalyst, carrying out uniform mixing under stirring, introducing nitrogen for 5 min and pouring the obtained mixture in a die with a certain shape; (3) subjecting the die to a reaction at 20 deg c for 30 min and then to a reaction at -28 deg c for 24 h; and (4) taking the product out and carrying out repeated water changing and soaking so as to obtain the finished hydrogel. the hydrogel prepared in the invention has obvious dual response to temperature and the ph value, excellence strength and an ultra-fast response rate; moreover, raw materials used in the invention are cheap; the preparation method is simple; and the hydrogel is expected to be used in fields like drug sustained release and dye absorption.

column10: floatable pharmaceutical microcapsule composition
column11: disclosed herein is a sustained release hollow core-shell microcapsule formulation for drug delivery comprising a hollow shell of one or more hydrophobic polymers, a drug containing hydrophilic or amphiphilic carrier matrix that is distributed over the inner surface of the hollow shell, a flotation agent, and an optional osmotic agent, wherein the microcapsule is capable of floating in a simulated digestive fluid for a period of from 24 to 96 hours. the microcapsules are prepared by a modified double emulsion (water/oil/water) solvent evaporation method. the microcapsule formulation may provide a sustained-release delivery system for treating chronic diseases such as parkinson's disease, diabetes and tuberculosis, all of which require multiple drug combination therapies. the aim is to reduce dosing frequency and pill burden, thus improving patient medication compliance. in a specific embodiment, the hollow shell is formed from a mixture of poly-l-lactide (plla) and poly(e-caprolactone) (pcl); and the amphiphilic carrier matrix is casein.

column10: method for preparing enzyme-sensitive amphiphilic polyester (pet) drug-loaded nanoparticles
column11: the invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of pharmaceutical polyester (pet) carriers and pharmaceutical preparations, and discloses a method for preparing enzyme-sensitive amphiphilic pet drug-loaded nanoparticles. the method comprises the following steps: 1) preparing amphiphilic pet-pcl-peptide; 2) preparing mepeg-cooh; 3) adding curcumin and pet-pcl-peptide to acetone for dissolution to form an oil phase, dissolving a surfactant in water to form a water phase, adding dropwise the oil phase to the water phase, and performing stirring to prepare nanoparticles; and 4) mixingby stirring a nanoparticle solution prepared in 3) with a mepeg-cooh solution at a certain concentration to obtain curcumin-nanoparticles with average particle size of 130-200 nm, polydispersity index(pdi) smaller than 0.30 and entrapment efficiency higher than 70%. the nanometer drug delivery carrier can be used as a curcumin-loaded sustained-release carrier system. inner lipophilic pet-cpl-pepitide layer is physically wrapped with outer hydrophilic mepeg-cooh layer to form particles, so that the nanoparticles have high targeting capacity, high bioavailability, low toxic and side effects, high stability, improved curcumin solubility and the like, and are suitable for various drug delivery methods such as intravenous injection.

column10: floatable pharmaceutical microcapsule composition
column11: disclosed herein is a sustained release hollow core-shell microcapsule formulation for drug delivery comprising a hollow shell of one or more hydrophobic polymers, a drug containing hydrophilic or amphiphilic carrier matrix that is distributed over the inner surface of the hollow shell, a flotation agent, and an optional osmotic agent, wherein the microcapsule is capable of floating in a simulateddigestive fluid for a period of from 24 to 96 hours. the microcapsules are prepared by a modified double emulsion (water/oil/water) solvent evaporation method. the microcapsule formulation may provide a sustained-release delivery system for treating chronic diseases such as parkinson's disease, diabetes and tuberculosis, all of which require multiple drug combination therapies. the aim is to reduce dosing frequency and pill burden, thus improving patient medication compliance. in a specific embodiment, the hollow shell is formed from a mixture of poly-l-lactide (plla) and poly(e-caprolactone)(pcl); and the amphiphilic carrier matrix is casein.

column10: preparation and application of drug delivery system of targeted liver gsdmd
column11: the invention relates to preparation and application of a drug delivery system of a targeted liver gsdmd, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: completely dissolving a small-molecule inhibitor aq-390 of a pyroptosis effect protein gsdmd with dmso; slowly dissolving the plga-peg-nh2 by using acetone; the preparation method comprises the following steps: adding completely dissolved aq-390 into acetone dissolved with plga, ultrasonically dispersing, slowly adding into distilled water, magnetically stirring at room temperature, and volatilizing an organic reagent acetone overnight at room temperature in a fuming cupboard to obtain the aq-390 (aq-390 at plga) wrapped by plga-peg-nh2 vesicles. the preparation process is simple and convenient, experimental conditions are easy to obtain, the liver can be well targeted, gsdmd is inhibited, and a theoretical basis and a new method are provided for development of novel clinical targeted therapy and diagnostic agents.

column10: preparation method of tumor microenvironment regulation type nano-drug delivery system as well as product and application of tumor microenvironment regulation type nano-drug delivery system
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of a tumor microenvironment regulation type nano-drug delivery system. the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, enabling dspe-peg-cooh to react with cai, and performing dialysis purification to obtain dspe-peg-cai; s2, dissolving and mixing lecithin, cholesterol and the dspe-peg-cai in the step s1, performing rotary evaporation to form a lipid film, and hydrating to obtain a liposome suspension; s3, a tumor cell membrane and the liposome suspension in the step s2 are mixed, and a tumor microenvironment regulation type biomimetic membrane is prepared through probe ultrasonic treatment; and s4, adding a chemotherapeutic drug into the biomimetic membrane in the step s3 to obtain the tumor microenvironment regulation type nano-drug delivery system. the invention further discloses the tumor microenvironment regulation type nano-drug delivery system prepared by the preparation method and application of the tumor microenvironment regulation type nano-drug delivery system in tumor treatment drugs. the tumor microenvironment regulation and control type nano-drug delivery system provided by the invention can regulate the tumor acidic microenvironment, the delivery efficiency of chemotherapeutic drugs is improved through dual tumor targeting of the biomimetic membrane, and the therapeutic effect of the chemotherapeutic drugs is effectively enhanced.

column10: sirna delivery material for targeting m2 type macrophages as well as preparation method and application of sirna delivery material
column11: the invention discloses a sirna (small interfering ribonucleic acid) delivery material for targeting m2 type macrophages. the sirna delivery material is prepared by assembling engineered polyethylene glycol peg-pry-m2, luteolin and zrcl4 in a depc (diethylpyrocarbonate) aqueous solution of sirna. the invention also discloses a preparation method and application thereof. the sirna delivery material of the targeted m2 type macrophage, which is synthesized by the invention, has excellent sirna carrying capacity, stable in-vivo targeting capacity, ideal microscopic size and relatively good biocompatibility. the sirna delivery material of the targeted m2 type macrophage has strong superiority in the aspects of sirna carrying and targeted delivery, and a theoretical basis is provided for the development of nano medicaments for subsequent delivery of biomacromolecules.

column10: preparation method and application of rhodiola rosea extracellular vesicle targeted drug delivery system with anti-melanoma effect

column10: polyethyleneimine derivative and application thereof as gene drug carrier
column11: the invention discloses a polyethyleneimine derivative and application thereof as a gene drug carrier. the polyethyleneimine derivative is obtained by connecting an iron chelating agent to a side chain of polyethyleneimine through an amido bond. polyethyleneimine is used as a basic carrier material and is connected with an iron metabolism regulating drug through an amido bond to synthesize a polyethyleneimine derivative, then the polyethyleneimine derivative is combined with a nucleic acid drug through self-assembly to form a nanoparticle core, and the nanoparticle core is connected with a peg terminal to form a final preparation. the invention provides a targeted epigenetic combined medication mode for the first time. different from a traditional administration mode, different drugs respectively aim at tumor iron metabolism and rna methylation, and the anti-tumor curative effect can be effectively enhanced.

column10: solid compositions for production of micelles for drug delivery
column11: the present technology relates to compositions comprising a crystalline peg copolymer, a hydrophobic drug, and optionally a peg homopolymer, wherein the composition is solid; the crystalline peg copolymer has at least one crystalline peg block and at least one polymer block other than peg; the peg homopolymer has a molecular weight from about 200 da to about 800 da; and the hydrophobic drug has a water solubility of <10 mg/ml at 25 °c. also provided are methods of making such compositions and for making drug-delivery micelles from such compositions.

column11: the invention discloses pillararene wp5-peg-dns and a preparation method and application thereof.the preparation method comprises the steps that under the protection of inert gas, hatu serves as a condensing agent, diisopropylethylamine serves as alkali, dmf serves as a solvent, a compound 1, amino polyethylene glycol, hatu, diisopropylethylamine and dmf are subjected to an amidation reaction, and an intermediate wp5-peg-nh2 is obtained; the method comprises the following steps: adding an intermediate wp5-peg-nh2 and 2, 4-dinitrobenzene sulfonyl chloride into a single-neck round-bottom flask, and reacting at room temperature by taking diisopropylethylamine as alkali and ch2cl2 as a solvent to obtain pillararene wp5-peg-dns; the pillararene wp5-peg-dns can be used for constructing a nano-drug carrier with excellent water solubility, a chemotherapy drug dox can be further loaded, combined treatment of chemotherapy and so2 gas is realized, and the tumor treatment effect is further improved.

column10: lithium acetate-polyethylene glycol mediated protoplast lipid nanoparticle delivery method
column11: the invention discloses a lithium acetate-polyethylene glycol mediated protoplast lipid nanoparticle delivery method, and belongs to the technical field of biology. liac is added into a protoplast conversion solution mmg for the first time, a peg formula is improved by increasing the concentration of calcium ions (ca < 2 + >), lipid nanoparticles (lnp) are successfully delivered into protoplasts of palm crops such as oil palm and coconut, mrna of enhanced green fluorescent protein (egfp) is wrapped in the nanoparticles, and the lipid nanoparticles can be used for preparing a biocarrier. the fluorescent protein can be directly expressed in the protoplast by taking mrna as a template without a promoter. after the lnp is delivered to the palm crop protoplast by the method, a green fluorescence signal is observed and detected by a laser confocal microscope. the method can be used for directly delivering the target gene mrna into the palm crop protoplast, and also can be used for delivering crispr/cas system protein and the like for gene editing technology research.

column10: preparation method and application of block polymer-metal organic framework coupled nano pesticide controlled release agent
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of a block polymer-metal organic framework coupled nano pesticide controlled release agent and application of the nano pesticide controlled release agent. comprising one or two of a block polymer-metal organic framework coupled nano-carrier, nicotine pesticides such as imidacloprid or thiamethoxam or dinotefuran and the like, and emamectin benzoate; and the nano carrier is an amphiphilic block polymer dspe-peg (polyethylene glycol) 2000-nh2 or dspe-ss-peg 2000-nh2 and an mofs (metal-organic frameworks) material. the block polymer-metal organic framework coupled nano-carrier can realize double loading of pesticide, obviously improves the loading capacity of effective components of the pesticide, and has the characteristic of controllable, accurate and continuous release. compared with a traditional pesticide formulation, the block polymer-metal organic framework coupled nano pesticide controlled release agent can efficiently kill agricultural lepidoptera and piercing (filing) sucking type pests such as spodoptera frugiperda and aphids, and has remarkable reduction and synergistic effects.

column10: paclitaxel prodrug, preparation method and application thereof
column11: a paclitaxel prodrug, includes a disulfide bond, a peg molecular chain, and a rgd peptide chain in the structure. the paclitaxel prodrug can self-assemble into micelles in an aqueous environment, with good in vitro stability. the introduced disulfide bond is conducive to the specific bond-breaking of the prodrug at the tumor sites, that can cause the disintegration of the prodrug micelles, damage the micelle morphology, and thus exhibit good sustained-release effects.

column10: sirna taking circhectd1 as target spot and delivery system, construction method and application thereof
column11: the invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicine, and particularly relates to sirna with circhectd1 as a target spot, a brain-targeted delivery system of the sirna, a construction method of the brain-targeted delivery system and application of the brain-targeted delivery system. the sirna comprises a positive-sense strand and an antisense strand, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the positive-sense strand comprises a modified or unmodified nucleotide sequence as shown in seq id no: 1; the nucleotide sequence of the seq id no: 1 is 5 '-gagcucacaauggucaactt-3', and the nucleotide sequence of the seq id no: 1 is 5 '- the nucleotide sequence of the antisense strand comprises a modified or unmodified nucleotide sequence as shown in seq id no: 2, and the nucleotide sequence of the seq id no: 2 is 5 '-guugaccauuguggagcuctt-3'. the sirna provided by the invention can silence the circhectd1 target gene. when the delivery system with the brain targeting function provided by the invention is used for delivering the sirna, the silence efficiency of the circhectd1 and the targeting property of the circhectd1 to mouse brain tissues can be further improved. the sirna delivery system comprises sirna, an electrified lipid and a brain-targeted functionalized peg (polyethylene glycol) lipid.

column10: macrophage membrane coated ros responsive bionic nano drug delivery system, preparation and application
column11: the invention relates to the field of traditional chinese medicine effective component new dosage form pharmaceutical preparations, and discloses an m2 type macrophage membrane coated ros responsive bionic nano drug delivery system, preparation and application. mesoporous silica is used as a core to load a traditional chinese medicine effective component, namely tripterine, and lipid components, namely pegylated distearoyl phosphatidyl ethanolamine (dspe-peg), dioleoyl lecithin (dopc), cholesterol and the like, are used as raw materials to prepare a ros-responsive lipid coating, so that ros-responsive tripterine mesoporous silica is formed. and then realizing bionic fusion with the m2 type macrophage membrane on the outer layer through an ultrasonic coating technology to prepare the m2 type macrophage membrane coated ros responsive bionic mesoporous silica nano drug delivery system. the invention can realize targeted therapy of rheumatoid arthritis, and has the advantages of biological safety and the like.

column10: citric acid fentanyl coated plga-peg nano-microsphere and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to citric acid fentanyl-coated plga-peg nano microspheres and a preparation method thereof. the preparation method comprises the following steps: step s1, preparing a citric acid fentanyl citrate solution and a plga-peg solution; step s2, dropwise adding the citric acid fentanyl solution into the plga-peg solution, mixing, and carrying out ultrasonic emulsification to obtain primary emulsion; s3, dropwise adding the primary emulsion into a pva (polyvinyl alcohol) solution, mixing, and carrying out ultrasonic emulsification to obtain multiple emulsion; and step s4, dropwise adding the multiple emulsion into water, stirring to volatilize the organic solvent, and performing centrifugal filtration to obtain the citric acid fentanyl coated plga-peg nano-microspheres. the plga-peg nano-carrier is adopted as a drug carrier to carry the citric acid fentanyl citrate, and compared with an existing oral administration citric acid fentanyl citrate preparation, slow release of the citric acid fentanyl citrate can be achieved.

column10: molybdenum disulfide nano-delivery system co-loaded with gambogic acid and cis-platinum and preparation method and application of molybdenum disulfide nano-delivery system
column11: the invention discloses a gambogic acid and cis-platinum co-loaded molybdenum disulfide nano delivery system. the system comprises the following components in parts by weight: 1-5 parts of molybdenum sulfide, 5-50 parts of manganese dioxide, 0.1-5 parts of gambogic acid, 1-50 parts of a cis-platinum prodrug pt (iv) and 10-50 parts of polyethylene glycol. the invention also provides a preparation method of the nano conveying system. according to the mos2-mno2-peg-pt (iv)/ga nano-drug delivery system constructed by the invention, the sequential release of the drug is controlled through gsh and near-infrared light, the tumor hypoxia drug resistance is reversed in combination with the characteristics of the carrier, the synergistic treatment effect of ga and cddp is maximized, and finally, the combined drug synergistic treatment and photo-thermal combined treatment of lung cancer are realized, so that the application prospect is wide. a new thought and a research strategy are provided for clinical treatment of lung cancer, and the application range of anti-cancer traditional chinese medicines in tumor treatment is expanded.

column10: ros responsive bionic nano drug delivery system, preparation method and application
column11: the invention relates to the field of traditional chinese medicine active ingredient new dosage form pharmaceutical preparations, and discloses an ros responsive bionic nano drug delivery system, a preparation method and application. the preparation method comprises the following steps: taking lipid components, namely soybean phospholipid (spc), hydrogenated soybean phospholipid (hspc), dipalmitoyl phosphatidylcholine (dppc), pegylated distearoyl phosphatidyl ethanolamine (dspe-peg), dioleoyl lecithin (dopc), (2, 2, 4-trimethyl-1, 3-pentanediol monoisobutyrate) and a surfactant, as well as an emulsifier, as well as a solvent; the ros-responsive leonurine lipidosome is prepared by taking 1, 3-dioleoyl-propyl)-trimethylamine (dotap), cholesterol and the like as raw materials to prepare nano-lipidosome, taking the nano-lipidosome as an inner core and coating the leonurine serving as a traditional chinese medicine effective component and catalase capable of catalyzing active oxygen to generate oxygen, so as to form the ros-responsive leonurine lipidosome. and then realizing bionic fusion with an activated neutrophile granulocyte membrane on the outer layer through a pneumatic nano extruder co-extrusion technology, so as to prepare the activated neutrophile granulocyte membrane coated ros responsive bionic nano-liposome drug delivery system. the invention can realize targeted therapy of rheumatoid arthritis and the like, and has the advantages of biological safety, slow release and the like.

column10: nano-drug delivery system capable of entering brain through nose and targeting central nervous system as well as preparation method and application of nano-drug delivery system
column11: the invention relates to the technical field of biological medicine, and particularly discloses a nano-drug delivery system entering brain through nose and targeting central nervous and a preparation method and application thereof. the nano-drug delivery system capable of entering the brain through the nose and targeting the central nervous system comprises a biological treatment drug and lectin coupled liposome nano-particles wrapping the surface of the biological treatment drug, the biological treatment medicine is mrna (messenger ribonucleic acid) coded biological macromolecules; the lectin is aal, and the raw materials of the lipidosome nanoparticles comprise sm102, dspc (distearoyl pyrrolidone), cholesterol, dmg-psar25 and dspe-peg-mal (distearoyl pyrrolidone-polyethylene glycol). according to the invention, aal and lnp with specific components are coupled, so that specific recognition and binding with receptor fucose of target cells are realized, nano-materials are helped to be endocytosed through olfactory mucosa and delivered to the brain through a nasal-brain pathway, biological treatment drugs are delivered in a targeted manner, the blood-brain barrier is broken through, and the targeting efficiency and nasal delivery efficiency are remarkably improved.

column11: the invention provides an application of alpha-ketoglutaric acid nanoparticles in preparation of a preparation for treating parkinson's disease. the alpha-ketoglutaric acid nano particles are rvg29-plga (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)-tk-peg (poly (ethylene glycol)-akg). the nanoparticles can specifically target neurons and penetrate through the blood brain barrier to improve the drug delivery efficiency. and alpha-ketoglutaric acid is released by responding to ros, so that the nerve cells are protected. the alpha-ketoglutaric acid nano-particles provided by the invention also have ferroptosis inhibition and oxidation resistance capabilities, and can be used for removing excessive active oxygen in the pathological state of parkinson's disease and inhibiting ferroptosis of nerve cells. in the application, the rvg29-plga-tk-peg-akg nano-particles show an excellent parkinson's disease treatment effect and controlled release capability, have a nano biological effect of resisting parkinson's disease, and have a wide application prospect in future clinical practice.

column10: folding mrna into a nanoscale delivery vehicle
column11: described herein is a dna nanotechnology-based platform for the delivery of nucleic acids into cells. the delivery platform relies on compacting cargo mrna and/or ssdna into single folded nanostructures that act as the primary structural vehicle material for nanoparticle delivery to cells. the described compositions and methods provide an alternative to packaging mrna or ssdna into lipid nanoparticle vehicles, which have complex formulation properties. also described herein are strategies for protecting mrna and/or ssdna cargo and helping these nucleic acid molecules escape the endosome into the cytoplasm using a cationic peptide-peg coating.

column11: the invention relates to the technical field of nanoparticles, in particular to nmn-containing oxidation-sensitive nanoparticles and a preparation method and application thereof.peg-puse-peg serves as a support, nmn and sod are wrapped, endogenous active oxygen generated by mitochondrial metabolism or nadph enzyme catalytic reaction can be reduced, exogenous active oxygen generated by exposure to ultraviolet rays or heterologous compounds can be reduced, and the nmn-containing oxidation-sensitive nanoparticles are prepared. and the peg-puse-peg not only serves as a stent of an oxidation-sensitive drug delivery system, but also has an effect of removing peroxy free radicals. alkyl selenide reacts with active oxygen such as hydrogen peroxide to form double-oxidized alkyl selenide, the double-oxidized alkyl selenide is converted into a liquid crystal state from an original colloidal crystal state, when the double-oxidized alkyl selenide passes through a skin barrier and encounters exogenous active oxygen, the deformability is increased, the hydrophilicity of a hydrophobic core is enhanced, the micelle form cannot be maintained, nmn and sod are released, and the double-oxidized alkyl selenide passes through keratinocyte gaps; and after entering deep cells of the skin, the nmn nano-particles have the effects of local targeted localization and high bioavailability of the nmn.

column10: model of quantification of 5fu quantity internalized in colorectal adenocarcinoma tumor cells following administration through polymeric nano systems labelled with dna sequences
column11: the invention relates to a method for making a model of quantification of the 5fu quantity internalized in colorectal adenocarcinoma tumor cells following the chemotherapy agent administration through controlled-release nanosystems of drug delivery system type. according to the invention, the method comprises the following steps: preparing the polymeric nano systems as reticulated structure, starting from acrylic acid-modified fibroin of natural silk (sf-ac) and tetraethylene glycol diacrylate (peg), loading the polymeric nano systems with 5fu, loading the nano systems with dna synthetic labels, obtaining cell cultures of colorectal adenocarcinoma belonging to the cell line ht-29 as in-vitro cell model of colorectal cancer, applying the treatments, followed by validation of nano system internalization by flow cytometry, detection and quantification of dna synthetic labels internalized in tumor cells ht-29 using the qrt-pcr technique, i.e. determining the quantity of 5fu internalized in target cells by means of polymeric nano systems, using an available computing algorithm, so that the model can provide an accurate control of the nano system administration dose and therapy effectiveness.

column10: ph-responsive sirna delivery system
column11: the invention relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to a ph responsive sirna delivery system for a tumor growth factor receptor. the delivery system provided by the invention comprises a molecule formed by a positive-sense strand ssrna modified by a polypeptide derivative and an antisense strand asrna modified by a peg derivative, polypeptide in the delivery system is c (rgdfk), peg derivative modified antisense strand asrna is formed by connecting and reacting methoxy polyethylene glycol propionaldehyde (mpeg-cho) molecules, coupling molecules and asrna, the peg molecular weight in the mpeg-cho is 500-20000, hydrazone bonds are formed between the mpeg-cho and the coupling molecules, the coupling molecules comprise 8-amino-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, the organic solvent is one or more of 2, 6-dioxaoctanoic acid, 4-(benzyl amino) benzoyl hydrazine, n-maleyl-beta-alanine and 3-maleimidopropionic acid. the delivery system can prolong the in-vivo circulation time of the sirna, inhibit metabolic accumulation of the sirna in the kidney and improve the tumor targeted delivery efficiency, thereby better achieving the silence effect of the sirna.

column10: fabrication of a ph-responsive nanoparticle for drug delivery
column11: targeted nano-drug delivery has been an effective and promising treatment of cancer since nanoparticles are equipped with numerous advantageous properties compared to traditional chemotherapy. this invention proposes an endosomal ph-responsive micellar nanoparticles. these ph-responsive nanoparticles were prepared by self-assembly of an amphiphilic poly(ethylene glycol)-imine-doxorubicin(peg-imine-dox) prodrug, and free dox could be encapsulated in the hydrophobic core of the nanoparticles. the peg-imine-dox prodrug is synthesized by three organic reactions with reactants peg-oh, p-carboxybenzaldehyde and dox. to achieve the prolonged systemic circulation time and quick release of the drug, biocompatible peg and highly hydrophilic dox are used as reactive materials. the prodrug peg-imine-dox nanoparticles exhibited excellent strong stability under normal physiological conditions but disassembled quickly in response to the faintly acidic environment. the method mentioned in this invention carries out a breakthrough in preceding cancer therapy that the hydrophilic nanoparticles possess high targeting capability to cancerous cells and mitigate the damage to healthy cells.

column11: the invention relates to a nano drug carrier with high tumor enrichment and infiltration, a preparation method therefor and an application of the nano drug carrier. the method comprises the steps: separately dissolving an antitumor drug and a dendritic polymer in dimethyl sulfoxide, and then, mixing the two kinds of solutions, so as to prepare a drug loaded dendritic polymer solution; adding nhs-peg-mal into the drug loaded dendritic polymer solution; and adding the mixture obtained in the previous step into a dialysis bag made from regenerated cellulose fibers, carrying out dialysis in purified water, then, carrying out ultrafiltration centrifugal purification by using an ultrafiltration tube, subjecting the obtained solution to a reaction with a targeted peptide, carrying out ultrafiltration centrifugal purification, and then, carrying out freeze-drying, thereby obtaining a nano drug carrier system. according to the system, the preparation method is easy and feasible; an antitumor drug paclitaxel can be covalently loaded through the nano-carrier, drug enrichment in tumor tissue can be achieved, effective infiltration of the drug into the tumor tissue is facilitated, and the efficiency of drug transportation is increased; and compared with a non-targeted control group, the tumor suppression ratio is increased to 56% from 39%.

column10: dendrimer based nanodevices for therapeutic and imaging purposes
column11: a nanodevice composition including n-acetyl cysteine linked to a dendrimer, such as a pamam dendrimer or a multiarm peg polymer, is provided. also provided is a nanodevice for targeted delivery of a compound to a location in need of treatment. the nanodevice includes a pamam dendrimer or multiarm peg polymer, linked to the compound via a disulfide bond. there is provided a nanodevice composition for localizing and delivering therapeutically active agents, the nanodevice includes a pamam dendrimer or multiarm peg polymer and at least one therapeutically active agent attached to the pamam dendrimer or multiarm peg polymer. a method of site-specific delivery of a therapeutically active agent, by attaching a therapeutically active agent to a pamam dendrimer or multiarm peg polymer using a disulfide bond, administering the pamam dendrimer or multiarm peg polymer to a patient in need of treatment, localizing the dendrimer or multiarm peg polymer to a site in need of treatment, and releasing the therapeutically active agent at the site in need of treatment.

column10: nanobody biomedicine transdermal administration formulation system and preparation method and use thereof
column11: the invention discloses a transdermal drug delivery scheme for preparing a specific nanobody biopharmaceutical through penetrating skin tissue, and its preparation method and application. due to biological characteristics such as unstable activity of traditional antibodies or protein macromolecules, the administration of biopharmaceuticals is basically limited to injections. nanobodies are the smallest units currently known to bind target antigens. the three-dimensional structure of nanobodies determines the relative stability of their structure and biological activity and their biological properties. nanobodies have the characteristics of high temperature resistance, activity in a certain acid-base environment, good water solubility, and strong tissue penetration. therefore, by optimizing the formulation of the carrier, the stability of the nanobody and the penetration of the skin tissue can be maintained and increased, so as to achieve a transdermal delivery formulation of the nanobody biopharmaceutical. the transdermal delivery of nanobody can be used for the specific nanobody to play a role in the local application area, and can also be used for the nanobody to penetrate the skin and enter the blood circulation to reach the site of a predetermined lesion. nanobodies in the transdermal delivery system include specific nanobodies for different lesion targets, such as, but not limited to, dermatological targets, inflammation and rheumatism targets, cancer targets, viral bacteria targets, cardiovascular disease targets, diabetes targets, alzheimer's disease targets, brain tumor targets. the carrier for transdermal delivery of the nanobody has the advantages of stabilizing the structure and efficacy of the nanobody, releasing the drug via the skin, and having good transdermal effect; the comfort of skin application is high; and the skin irritation and allergic reaction characteristics are basically absent. the carrier system components include, but not limited to, soluble polymer macromolecular carbohydrate matrix, polyethylene glycol (peg), dextran, polyamino acid, optimized formulation, stirred mixture. the invention discloses a preparation method and application of the transdermal drug delivery system. transdermal administration is a safe and effective method of administration. less content of proteolytic enzymes in the skin tissue is conducive to maintaining the stability of such biological drugs. the nanobody biomedical transdermal drug delivery preparation system has the advantages of being non-toxic, stable, controllable, convenient for administration, and easy to operate, etc., and opens up new dosage forms of nanobody biopharmaceuticals, and its application prospect is very broad.

column10: synthesis and application of polyethylene glycol (peg) with two ends simultaneously coupled with anti-tumor drug conjugates

column10: pegylated dendritic macromolecule drug carrier and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention relates to a preparation method of a pegylated dendritic macromolecule drug carrier, which comprises the following steps of: mixing trimethylolpropane triacrylate and ethylenediamine inan ice-water bath, reacting alternately in an organic solvent in a protective atmosphere at the reaction temperature of 25-60 deg c, obtaining an amino-terminated dendritic macromolecule using ethylenediamine as a core or an acrylate-terminated dendritic macromolecule using trimethylolpropane triacrylate as a core; dissolving peg, p-nitrophenyl chloroformate and triethylamine in an organic solvent, reacting at 20-30 deg c, and obtaining pegylated p-nitrophenyl carbonate after the reaction is complete; reacting the amino-terminated dendritic macromolecule using the ethylenediamine as the core or acrylate-terminated dendritic macromolecule using the trimethylolpropane triacrylate as the core with the pegylated p-nitrophenyl carbonate in an organic solvent at a reaction temperature of 20-30 deg c. the method is easy to operate, high in yield and low in cost; and the prepared drug carrier has excellent drug carrying performance on drugs which are difficult in dissolving in water.

column10: structure of targeting nano-micelle with double-ligand reversible mutual shielding and drug delivery system
column11: the invention relates to a structure of a targeting nano-micelle with double-ligand reversible mutual shielding and a drug delivery system. the structure is acquired according to a method of mixing three amphiphilic block copolymers, namely, phenylboronic acid-polyethylene glycol-b-polyester (pba-peg-pe), galactose-polyethylene glycol-b-polyester (gal-peg-pe) and polyethylene glycol-b-polyester (peg-pe) and then self-assembling under hydrophilic and hydrophobic action; molar ratio of pba-peg-pe to gal-peg-pe is at 1:(0.1-10); mole percent of peg-pe in total polymers in micelle is 0%-90%. the structure of the targeting nano-micelle with double-ligand reversible mutual shielding is capable of wrapping lyophobic anti-cancer drugs so as to be prepared into the drug delivery system. in blood circulation, two ligands in the micelle combine with each other so as to achieve a shielding function, reduce recognition and intake of res and prolong circulation time; in tumor areas, the combining capacity of the two ligands is weakened and the targeting capacity to cancer cells is recovered; the shielding-deshielding capacity is repeatably reversible. according to the invention, enrichment of nano-micelle loaded drugs on tumor sites can be increased, so that the tumor therapeutic effect of drugs can be promoted.

column10: an acid-responsive nanometer micelle for drug loading, a preparation method and an application thereof
column11: the invention discloses an acid-responsive nanometer micelle for drug loading, a preparation method and an application thereof. the nano-micelles were self-assembled from hydrophilic segment polyethylene glycol (peg) and hydrophobic segment ph-sensitive polyaspartyl diisopropylethylenediamine/di-n-butylethylenediamine (pasp (dip/dba)). the nano-micelles can prolong the drug circulation time, aggregate in the tumor site, increase the local drug concentration, and respond to the micro-acid environment of the tumor tissue. as a drug carrier of stimulation response, the nano-micelles can rapidly release the loaded chemotherapeutic drug adriamycin in the tumor site, and play a significant anti-tumor effect. at the same time, the nano-micelles loaded with magnetic resonance contrast agent superparamagnetic iron oxide can be used for tumor magnetic resonance imaging and monitoring drug uptake and aggregation. this method utilizes nano-drug aggregation at tumor site and acid responsiveness ofcarrier to realize rapid drug release to improve tumor therapeutic effect, and endows nano-micellar mri visualization function, which provides a promising innovative strategy for cancer diagnosis andtreatment, and has broad application prospects.

column10: preparation method and application of drug-loading nano-micelles responding arterial plaque micro-environment
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method and application of drug-loading nano-micelles responding an arterial plaque micro-environment. the nano-micelle is prepared from a diblock polymer containing a hydrophilic segment of polyethylene glycol and a hydrophobic segment of polypropylene sulfide through self-assembly. the peg-pps micelle can disintegrate in response to plaque reactive oxygen species (ros), consume ros in the lesion site and effectively inhibit the ros. the micelle can be used as a drug carrier for stimulating response, fast release the loaded drug andro, reduce inflammatoryresponse in the lesion site and significantly improve the plaque treatment effects. through the oxidative responsiveness of the carrier, drug release is realized, anti-inflammatory effects are obtained and oxidative stress is relieved. the drug-loading nano-micelles provide the promising innovative therapeutic strategy for atherosclerosis and have a broad application prospect.

column11: the invention relates to a compound nano drug carrier system with tumor promotion target capability and a preparation method of the system. the preparation method comprises the steps of connecting a 2,4,6-trimethoxybenzene ring to the surface of a mesoporous silicon nanoparticle through an epoxy ester bond, adopting beta-cyclodextrin as a 'valve' material, capping the surface of the mesoporous silicon nanoparticle with the beta-cyclodextrin by a subject-object effect of the cyclodextrin and the benzene ring, and grafting benzaldehyde terminated peg (polyethylene glycol) to the surface of the beta-cyclodextrin through a ph (potential of hydrogen) sensitive imine bond to construct the compound nano drug carrier system capable of performing targeted release of a drug in a tumor cell. the constructed peg/beta-cd/msn (polyethylene glycol/beta-cyclodextrin/mesoporous silicon nanoparticle) compound nano drug carrier system is high in drug loading capacity, has double ph sensitivity mechanismsand more efficient targeted administration capability in the cancer cell, and can effectively increase a utilization ratio of the drug, reduce toxic and side effects of the drug, and better achieve targeted controlled release treatment of a cancer.

column11: the invention discloses a block branched polymer drug carrier and a preparation method and application thereof. by using n-isopropyl acrylamide polymer as a monomer, macro-molecular poly(glycol)dimer as an initiator, dodecyl mercaptan as a chain transferring agent and n,n'-vinyl bisacrylamide as a cross-linking agent, a biocompatible block branched polymer drug carrier peg-b-pnipam is synthesized through free radical polymerization. according to the method, loading of a drug can be completed at room temperature; and the drug carrier is easy to disperse in water to form a waterborne drug nanosuspension and is beneficial to release drug from drug nanoparticles. drug loading in nanoparticles is improved and complexity of drug evaluation is reduced, drug dissolvability is raised, and nanoparticles show good stability. the product is easy to store and transport.

column10: special coated controlled-release insecticide for peanuts and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention relates to the technical field of insecticides and particularly relates to a special coated controlled-release insecticide for peanuts. the insecticide comprises a structure of three layers, i.e., an inner layer, a middle layer and an outer layer, wherein the inner layer is prepared from the raw materials: phoxim, imidacloprid, chlorpyrifos, chlorantraniliprole, wheat bran, humic acid and a binder; the middle layer is prepared from the raw materials: phoxim, imidacloprid, chlorpyrifos, chlorantraniliprole and ureaformaldehyde powder; the outer layer is prepared from the raw materials: ureaformaldehyde powder and livestock and poultry fermented manure. the insecticide is applied into a fruiting layer during sowing, does not release an insecticide effect at a primary stage of generation and is subjected to coating decomposition and insecticide effect release about 50 days after the insecticide is applied into soil before the peanuts peg and pod, so that the consumption of pesticides can be lowered, non-point source pollution is prevented, underground insect pests can be effectively controlled in a high pointed manner, the loss of toxicity and pesticide toxicity of the pesticides can be avoided, the consumption of the pesticides can be lowered, the environmental pollution is lowered, the storage and transportation are safe, the processing cost is low, and the market prospect is good.

column10: drug delivery of temozolomide for systemic based treatment of cancer
column11: the present invention relates to methods of drug delivery for the treatment of a condition or disease, such as cancer. in one embodiment, the invention provides a method of preparing a multifunctional nanoconjugate of temozolomide (tmz) by conjugating tmz in its hydrazide form to a polymalic acid platform. in another embodiment, the polymalic acid platform is conjugated to a monoclonal antibody to transferrin receptor, a trileucine (lll) moiety, and/or a polyethylene glycol (peg) moiety. the present invention relates to methods of drug delivery for the treatment of a condition or disease, such as cancer. in one embodiment, the invention provides a method of preparing a multifunctional nanoconjugate of temozolomide (tmz) by conjugating tmz in its hydrazide form to a polymalic acid platform. in another embodiment, the polymalic acid platform is conjugated to a monoclonal antibody to transferrin receptor, a trileucine (lll) moiety, and/or a polyethylene glycol (peg) moiety.

column10: tumor-targeted delivery carrier based on cell-derived micro-vacuoles, preparation method and application
column11: the invention discloses a tumor-targeted delivery carrier based on cell-derived micro-vacuoles, a preparation method and an application. the preparation method comprises the following steps of: (a) preparing a conditioned medium: supplementing fetal bovine serum, antibiotics, dspe-peg-biotin and dspe-peg-folate into a basal medium; (b) using the obtained conditioned medium in cell culture, and collecting cell culture supernatant for subsequent separation; (c) carrying out low-speed centrifugation on the obtained culture supernatant to remove cell debris and apoptotic bodies, then adding sa-ionps, mixing uniformly, incubating, then separating by a magnet, using pbs for re-suspension, eluting for multiple times to obtain the cell-derived micro-vacuoles with membrane surfaces modified by folic acid and iron oxide nano-particles, and freezing for storage; and (d) loading chemotherapeutic drugs or therapeutic genes into the functionalized micro-vacuoles doubly-modified by an electroporation mode, and carrying out re-suspension after separation with the magnet. the tumor-targeted delivery carrier based on cell-derived micro-vacuoles, the preparation method and the application disclosed by the invention are applicable to specific targeting delivery of multiple chemotherapeutic drugs and therapeutic genes, and have the advantages of enhancing the anti-tumor effect, reducing the systemic toxicity and improving the clinical effect of the current therapeutic selection, so that a new hope is brought for clinical therapy of tumors.

column11: in this work we have targeted two aspects of gqds, size and ros to reduce their cytotoxicity. small size can damage cell organelles and production of ros (reactive oxygen species) can hamper cell machinery in multiple ways. we have shown that cytotoxicity can be significantly reduced by embedding gqds inside the peg matrix rather than creating a thin shell around each gqd. thin peg shell around gqd can control ros production but cannot circumvent the toxicity due to small size. thus it was essential to solve both the issues. we have used a simple electrochemical method (12 h at room temperature) for synthesizing gqds and embedded them in peg matrix via a simple one step hydrothermal reaction (24 h at 160° c.) involving only gqds, peg, and deionized water. the p-gqds formed after hydrothermal reaction show nanoparticles of diameter of ˜80-100 nm containing gqds entrapped in peg matrix. mtt assay showed significant 60% cells viability at a very high concentration of 5.5 mg/ml of p-gqds compared to 10-15% viability for c-gqd and h-gqd. ros production by p-gqds was least compared to c-gqd and h-gqd in cell free and intracellular ros assay suggesting involvement of ros in cytotoxicity. in this work we have solved the issue of cytotoxicity due to ‘small size’ and ‘ros generation’ without compromising with fluorescence properties of gqds. p-gqds was used for bioimaging and drug delivery in hela cells. in short we can obtain biocompatible p-gqds in very short span of time with minimal use of hazardous chemicals and simple methodology.

column10: biocompatible graphene quantum dots for drug delivery and bioimaging applications
column11: in this work we have targeted two aspects of gqds, size and ros to reduce their cytotoxicity. small size can damage cell organelles and production of ros (reactive oxygen species) can hamper cell machinery in multiple ways. we have shown that cytotoxicity can be significantly reduced by embedding gqds inside the peg matrix rather than creating a thin shell around each gqd. thin peg shell around gqd can control ros production but cannot circumvent the toxicity due to small size. thus it was essential to solve both the issues. we have used a simple electrochemical method (12 h at room temperature) for synthesizing gqds and embedded them in peg matrix via a simple one step hydrothermal reaction (24 h at 160° c.) involving only gqds, peg, and deionized water. the p-gqds formed after hydrothermal reaction show nanoparticles of diameter of ˜80-100 nm containing gqds entrapped in peg matrix. mtt assay showed significant 60% cells viability at a very high concentration of 5.5 mg/ml of p-gqds compared to 10-15% viability for c-gqd and h-gqd. ros production by p-gqds was least compared to c-gqd and h-gqd in cell free and intracellular ros assay suggesting involvement of ros in cytotoxicity. in this work we have solved the issue of cytotoxicity due to ‘small size’ and ‘ros generation’ without compromising with fluorescence properties of gqds. p-gqds was used for bioimaging and drug delivery in hela cells. in short we can obtain biocompatible p-gqds in very short span of time with minimal use of hazardous chemicals and simple methodology.

column10: magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle particle and preparation method therefor
column11: a magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle particle and a preparation method therefor. in the method, n-isopropylacrylamide, n,n-dimethylacrylamide, polylactic acid, etc. are used as raw materials to synthesize a thermosensitive p(nipam-co-dmam)-b-pla triblock polymer; a dextran-magnetic lamellar composite hydroxide-fluorouracil magnetic sustained-release drug delivery system is assembled at the core of the thermosensitive micelle by simultaneous hydration and dialysis, so as to prepare a magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle having magnetic response and temperature-sensitivity; and water-soluble near-infrared cdhgte quantum dots (qd) are grafted onto the surface of the magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive micelle layer using an electrostatic binding technique, so as to finally prepare dmf@trm@qd fluorescent micellar particles having near-infrared fluorescence emission, magnetic targeting, and thermosensitive controlled-release properties. the product of the present invention features an appropriate lcst, a simple process, low costs, a high drug load, good water solubility, and high sol stability. the micellar particle has ideal thermosensitive properties, magnetic targeting properties, and fluorescent tracer functions, and has special application prospects in the fields of targeted tumor therapy and magnetically induced thermotherapy.
