column10: magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle particle and preparation method therefor
column11: a magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle particle and a preparation method therefor. in the method, n-isopropylacrylamide, n,n-dimethylacrylamide, polylactic acid, etc. are used as raw materials to synthesize a thermosensitive p(nipam-co-dmam)-b-pla triblock polymer; a dextran-magnetic lamellar composite hydroxide-fluorouracil magnetic sustained-release drug delivery system is assembled at the core of the thermosensitive micelle by simultaneous hydration and dialysis, so as to prepare a magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle having magnetic response and temperature-sensitivity; and water-soluble near-infrared cdhgte quantum dots (qd) are grafted onto the surface of the magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive micelle layer using an electrostatic binding technique, so as to finally prepare dmf@trm@qd fluorescent micellar particles having near-infrared fluorescence emission, magnetic targeting, and thermosensitive controlled-release properties. the product of the present invention features an appropriate lcst, a simple process, low costs, a high drug load, good water solubility, and high sol stability. the micellar particle has ideal thermosensitive properties, magnetic targeting properties, and fluorescent tracer functions, and has special application prospects in the fields of targeted tumor therapy and magnetically induced thermotherapy.

column10: preparation method of polylactic acid nano microspheres

column10: triadimefon*propiconazole polylactic acid microsphere and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses a triadimefon*propiconazole polylactic acid microsphere and a preparation method thereof. the method comprises the following steps: taking a triadimefon*propiconazole compoundmedicine as a core material, taking a biodegradable material polylactic acid (pla) as a wall material, and preparing the triadimefon*propiconazole polylactic acid sustained release microsphere by an emulsion-solvent evaporation method. the influence of each experimental factor on the microsphere preparation process is investigated by a single factor, and with the adoption of an orthogonal experiment, the preparation process is further optimized. the optimal process conditions of the microsphere are screened as follows: the mass ratio of the core material to the wall material is 1:3, the mass fraction of the emulsifier is 1.50%, the volume ratio of oil and water phases is 1:20, the polylactic acid concentration is 120 mg/ml, the high-speed dispersion time is 0.6min, the high-speed dispersion speed is 4000 revolutions per minute, the magnetic stirring time is 3 hours, and the magnetic stirring speed is 600 revolutions per minute.

column10: biodegradable material loaded pesticide microsphere suspending agent and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention relates to a biodegradable material loaded pesticide microsphere suspending agent and a preparation method thereof. the preparation method is characterized in that the commixture of biodegradable polypropylene carbonate ppc and polylactic acid pla is used as the wall material to prepare emamectin benzoate sustained-release microspheres, and a wetting dispersant, a thickening agent, an anti-freezing agent and water are added to service as the auxiliary materials to prepare the emamectin benzoate microsphere suspending agent. the emamectin benzoate microsphere suspending agent comprises, 45-120g/l of emamectin benzoate microspheres, 35-60g/l of wetting dispersant, 2.4-5g/l of thickening agent aluminum-magnesium silicate and sodium alginate, 25-50g/l of anti-freezing agent ethylene glycol and the balance water. the suspending agent and the preparation method thereof have the advantages that the cost of the compound wall material used by the suspending agent is lowered, the environment friendliness of the compound wall material is increased, the compound wall material can be naturally biodegraded into carbon dioxide and water after the suspending agent is applied to fields, the compound wall material is good in environment compatibility, and harm, caused by the heavy use of non-degraded wall materials such as polyurea, to environments is reduced.

column10: injectable and biodegradable polymer formulations for controlled release of bioligic agents
column11: the present disclosure is directed to injectable formulations that include biodegradable polymers based on trimethylene carbonate (tmc) with mole fractions of polylactic acid (pla) and/or polyglycolic acid (pga) that are used to deliver a bioactive agent to a targeted site. excipients such as polyethylene glycol (peg) may be added to the formulations to reduce the injection force and/or to modulate the release of the bioactive agent. suitable biodegradable polymers for use in the injectable formulations include d,l-pla:tmc, d-pla:tmc, l-pla:tmc, tmc:pla:pga and variations thereof. additionally, copolymers of tmc and pla and terpolymers of tmc:pla:pga may be formed into nanoparticles and delivered to the target site with an injectable crosslinkable polyethylene glycol system. in at least one embodiment, the injectable formulations are used to treat ocular diseases.

column10: biodegrading implantable ocular sustained release drug delivery system
column11: an ocular implant is provided for an intraocular delivery of a therapeutic biologic agent. the implant may be used intracamerally or intravitreally. the implant may include a sustained-release biodegradable core and a biodegradable shell, wherein the shell has a longer biodegradable half-life than the core. the core may include a biodegradable gel medium, an active therapeutic biologic agent, and a biologic stabilizer. upon insertion into the anterior chamber or vitreous body of an eye, the therapeutic biologic agent is released over an extended period, that may range from one day to one year. the therapeutic biologic agent may be, for example, tissue-plasminogen activator, an anti-vegf agent, or another biopharmaceutical. the biodegradable implant may completely dissolve after implantation and need not be removed.

column10: preparation of polyoxometallate supported anticancer nanometer preparation
column11: the invention discloses a polyoxometallate supported anticancer nanometer preparation and a preparation method thereof. the used polyoxometallates (poms) are novel inorganic materials and have huge potential in treatment application of cancers. however, since the poms are low in water solubility and unstable in an aqueous phase, the application of the poms in the anticancer field is limited. the preparation method disclosed by the invention comprises the following steps: coating materials (pla-peg2000, tpgs-cooh) with biocompatibility so as to prepare a nano-carrier; modifying the surface of the nano-carrier by utilizing targeted molecular folic acid, and finally preparing the polyoxometallate supported anticancer nanometer preparation with the functions of in-vivo long circulation, active targeting, high curative effects, small toxic and side effects, high stability and the like. the polyoxometallate supported anticancer nanometer preparation is expected to fully achieve effects in the cancer treatment field. the polyoxometallate supported anticancer nanometer preparation disclosed by the invention provides a novel thought for development of a nano drug delivery system for treating cancers and has great theoretical research significances and potential application values.

column10: preparation method of sustained-release leuprolide acetate microspheres
column11: the invention aims at providing a preparation method of sustained-release leuprolide acetate microspheres. the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dissolving leuprolide acetate in water for injection, thus forming leuprolide acetate aqueous solution for injection, wherein the concentration of leuprolide acetate is 1g/ml-2.5g/ml; (2) dissolving pla in methylene dichloride, thus forming pla methylene dichloride solution, wherein the concentration of pla in the pla methylene dichloride solution is 280mg/ml-350mg/ml; (3) mixing the leuprolide acetate aqueous solution for injection obtained in the step (1) and the pla methylene dichloride solution obtained in the step (2), and carrying out ultrasonic treatment to obtain primary emulsion; (4) adding the primary emulsion obtained in the step (3) into pva solution, and carrying out stirring to obtain compound emulsion; and (5) stirring the compound emulsion, filtering the stirred compound emulsion, adding mannitol solution into microsphere wet products, and carrying out freeze-drying to obtain the sustained-release leuprolide acetate microspheres.

column10: preparation method for methoprene microcapsules
column11: the invention relates to a preparation method for methoprene microcapsules. the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, carrier preparation is carried out, namely, a polymerization reaction with a mol ratio of succinic acid, butylene glycol and lactic acid being 1:1:0.2-0.3 is carried out, and a carrier pbs-co-pla is obtained; secondly, oil phase preparation is carried out, namely, pbs-co-pla, methoprene and dichloromethane are weighed with a mass ratio of pbs-co-pla, methoprene and dichloromethane being 3.5-4.5:1:10, the pbs-co-pla carrier is dissolved in dichloromethane, after the pbs-co-pla is dissolved in dichloromethane fully, the methoprene active compound is added and dissolved and an oil phase is obtained; thirdly, water phase preparation is carried out, deionized water is measured and taken with a mass ratio of the oil phase to the water phase being 1:5-7, an emulsifier dispersant is added in water and dissolved and a water phase is obtained; fourthly, microcapsule preparation is carried out, namely, the oil phase is added in the water phase, an oil and water mixed emulsion is obtained, an antifoaming agent is added, microcapsule suspension is prepared after curing, water washing is carried out, the supernatant is removed, and a finished product is obtained after drying. the method is simple in technology and is environmentally friendly. the obtained methoprene microcapsules have a good form, the encapsulation efficiency is 78%, the drug loading capacity is 50%, the effective release period is 30 days, the drug release amount is 94%, and the methoprene microcapsule is an ideal pesticide sustained release agent.

column10: preparation method of methyl parathion microcapsules

column10: interferon alpha-2b sustained-release oral patch and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention provides an interferon alpha-2b sustained-release oral patch and a preparation method thereof. nanoparticles are prepared by adopting a multiple emulsion-solvent evaporation method or reduced pressure distillation, and freeze-dried powder of the nanoparticles and auxiliary materials are pressed into the oral patch. a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (plga) is used as a nano-particle carrier, and interferon alpha-2b is wrapped inside, so that the stability of the interferon alpha-2b is improved, the slow release of the interferon alpha-2b can be controlled, and the half-life period of plasma can be prolonged. the prepared nanoparticles are round and normal, uniform in dispersion, stable in property and good in resolubility after being freeze-dried, in-vitro release is in conformity with the characteristics of a long-acting preparation, the particle size is mainly distributed within a range of 50-1,000 nm, the in-vivo half-life period is prolonged to 120-600 h, the encapsulation efficiency is about 70%-90%, and the drug loading capacity of the interferon alpha-2b sustained-release oral patch is 8-45 <mu>g. the nanoparticles are freeze-dried and then are uniformly mixed with the auxiliary materials such as hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, carbomer, magnesium stearate and the like, the mixture is pressed into tablets, and the tablets can be applied to sustained-release administration of oral patches.

column11: the invention discloses a 5-boron pyridine carboxylic acid modified targeted drug delivery system and a preparation method thereof. the system comprises a negatively charged 5-boron pyridine carboxylic acid aqueous solution and positively charged drug-loaded nanoparticles, and the two are combined through electrostatic interaction. the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) carryingout ring-opening copolymerization on lactide (la) and glycolide (ga) to obtain a polymer plga, carrying out amidation reaction on the polymer plga and polyethyleneimine (pei) through functionalization, and performing grafting of the pei to obtain a plga-pei amphiphilic copolymer; (2) carrying out self-assembly on the plga-pei amphiphilic polymer and a drug in a water phase to form drug-loaded nanoparticles with positive charges on the surfaces; and (3) adding the negatively charged 5-boron pyridine carboxylic acid into the drug-loaded nanoparticles with positive charges on the surfaces to form the drug delivery system. the drug delivery system disclosed by the invention has efficient targeting property and high biocompatibility on tumor cells, and is beneficial to carrying drugs to be efficiently enriched in tumor tissues and enter the tumor cells, so that the drug delivery effect is greatly improved, and the purpose of treatment of tumors is achieved.

column10: preparation method of finasteride sustained release microsphere
column11: the invention provides a preparation method of a sustained release microsphere for treating benign prostatic hyperplasia. the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving the raw material drug, namely, finasteride in sterile water for injection, thus obtaining an inner water phase for later use; dissolving poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) (plga) in methylene dichloride, thus obtaining an oil phase for later use; preparing polyving akohol aqueous solution with the concentration being 1.0%, thus obtaining an outer water phase for later use; dropwise adding the inner water phase into the oil phase, and carrying out ultrasonic emulsification for 20min, thus obtaining primary emulsion; after the primary emulsion is stable, dropwise adding the primary emulsion into the outer water phase, and carrying out magnetic stirring for 4.0h; carrying out drying and storage on the product at the normal temperature; and collecting the microspheres. for the dosage form of finasteride, with the interventional therapy surgical method, the prepared finasteride sustained release microsphere is delivered to the local part of the prostate glands, the curative effects can be greatly improved, and toxic and side effects can be reduced.

column11: the invention provides a preparation method of an erinacine/plga microsphere. the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving plga into dichloromethane to form an organic phase; adding erinacine extract into the obtained organic phase, carrying out an ultrasonic treatment to obtain suspension; adding the suspension into a gelatin water solution, stirring the solution in a speed of 300 to 1500 rpm/min at a temperature of 5 to 30 deg c to carry out emulsification for 5 to 85 minutes, then stirring the solution in a speed of 100 to 500 rpm/min at a room temperature to completely evaporate dichloromethane so as to precipitate the microspheres; carrying out centrifugation at a temperature of 0 to 4 deg c, collecting the precipitated microspheres, washing the microspheres by distilled water, and freeze-drying microspheres in vacuum to obtain the finished product. the preparation method has the advantages that the encapsulation rate of prepared erinacine/plga microsphere is high, moreover, the erinacine/plga microsphere has a sustained-release function, the bioavailability is high, the preparation technology is simple and convenient, the preparation cost is low, the technological repeatability is good, the using amount of sample is little, and the preparation method has an important meaning for industrial application.

column10: slow-release gel drug delivery system for postoperative intracavitary chemotherapy/immune co-treatment as well as preparation method and application of sustained-release gel drug delivery system
column11: the invention discloses a sustained-release gel drug delivery system for postoperative intracavitary chemotherapy/immune co-treatment as well as a preparation method and application of the sustained-release gel drug delivery system. the sustained-release drug delivery system is a drug delivery system prepared by embedding a ptx prodrug targeting nanoparticle and a cpg targeting polymer nanoparticle into a temperature-sensitive gel material serving as a skeleton, wherein the temperature-sensitive gel material is a poly(lactic-co-hydroxyacetic acid)-poly(ethylene glycol)-poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) triblock copolymer. according to the invention, chemical treatment and immunotherapy are combined and are taken together to kill residual glioma cells and play a role in synergistic treatment, and the purposes of slowly releasing drugs and treating glioma in situ can also be achieved.

column10: preparation method of polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone)-polycaprolactone-poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) graft copolymer micelle
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone)-polycaprolactone-poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) graft copolymer micelle. the preparation method comprises following steps: 1, polyacrylic acid, hydroxyl-terminated poly(p-dioxanone), hydroxyl-terminated polycaprolactone, hydroxyl-terminated poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid), a solvent, a condensing agent are delivered into a dried reactor, an obtained mixture is reacted for 2 to 4 days so as to obtain a three-graft copolymer; 2, the three-graft copolymer and the solvent are delivered into a dried reactor, dissolving is carried out for 40 to 60min so as to obtain a three-graft copolymer stock solution; 3, at room temperature, the three-graft copolymer stock solution is delivered into a dialysis bag, the dialysis bag is delivered into a beaker containing a selective solvent, the selective solvent is replaced for 3 to 4 times until blue light is emitted by an obtained solution in the dialysis bag, the solution in the dialysis bag is delivered into a volumetric flask with scales, and is diluted with the selective solvent to a certain volume so as to obtain a target product. the preparation method is simple; operation is convenient; and the obtained target product is a novel drug carrier.

column10: preparation method of targeted multifunctional polymeric niosomes
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of targeted multifunctional polymeric niosomes. the preparation method comprises the following steps: modifying poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) with maleic anhydride through bulk reaction, and performing amidation reaction on the modified poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) to further react with amino groups of branched polyethyleneimine or amino-terminated polyethyleneglycol, thereby preparing an amphipathic block copolymer; reacting with ferroferric oxide nanoparticles, performing a double emulsification and ultrasonic dispersion method and a vacuum drying technology, and then grafting folic acid on the surface; and finally, performing vacuum drying to prepare the niosomes, wherein the niosomes have targeting property and simultaneously have a function of carrying hydrophilic/hydrophobic drugs and carrying genes. the targeted multifunctional polymeric niosomes prepared by the invention are controllable and stable in particle diameter, have controllable and selective drug release positions, speeds and modes, can protect active groups of drugs from being degraded in the in vivo environment, and can prolong the circulation time of the drugs in blood, thereby hopefully becoming a novel efficient drug delivery and gene therapy carrier.

column11: the invention discloses a method for preparing high-strength regenerated cellulose filaments, and belongs to the technical field of textiles. the preparation method of the high-strength regenerated cellulose filament comprises the following steps: firstly, pretreating bacterial cellulose to obtain a bacterial cellulose filter cake; dissolving the bacterial cellulose filter cake in nmmo (n-methylmorpholine-n-oxide) to obtain a transparent bacterial cellulose solution; adding a cross-linking solution prepared from tannic acid and/or polyethylene glycol diglycidyl ether into the bacterial cellulose solution for cross-linking reaction to obtain a spinning solution; and finally, carrying out wet spinning on the spinning solution to obtain the high-strength regenerated cellulose filament. the high-strength regenerated cellulose filament has high mechanical performance and stability, and can be widely applied to artificial tissue repair materials and drug sustained-release carriers in the field of biomedicine, antibacterial packaging materials in the field of food packaging and the like.

column11: the invention provides a lipid nanoparticle composition for nucleic acid drug delivery and a preparation method and application thereof. the lipid nanoparticle composition provided by the invention comprises three lipid components, namely a steroid-cationic lipid compound, neutral phospholipid and polyethylene glycol lipid. the composition prepared by mixing has better stability and transfection efficiency. when the lipid nanoparticles are used for delivering nucleic acid, such as mrna (messenger ribonucleic acid), a nucleic acid drug can be efficiently and stably delivered to target cells or organs, relatively high specific antibody response can be caused in an experimental animal body, and the compound has better safety.

column10: polyester-polyethylene glycol block copolymer as well as preparation method and application thereof
column11: the invention relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, in particular to a polyester-polyethylene glycol block copolymer as well as a preparation method and application thereof. the preparation method of the polyester-polyethylene glycol block copolymer comprises the following steps: by taking stannous octoate as a catalyst, carrying out melt ring-opening polymerization reaction on hydroxyl-containing polyethylene glycol and cyclic ester monomers; in the melt ring-opening polymerization, the use amount of the stannous octoate is 0.01 wt%-0.047 wt% of the total amount of the hydroxyl-containing polyethylene glycol and the cyclic ester monomer raw materials; the temperature of the melting ring-opening polymerization reaction is 100-140 deg c, and the reaction time is 48-150 hours. the polyester-polyethylene glycol block copolymer with the content of residual metal, monomers and oligomers meeting the requirements of a drug carrier is synthesized through a one-step method, the purification step is not needed, the technological process is shortened, the production efficiency and the product yield are improved, and wider commercial application can be achieved easily.

column10: complex gel at tail end of dopamine loaded with sinapine and application of complex gel
column11: the invention provides sinapine-loaded dopamine-terminated composite gel and application thereof, relates to the technical field of food processing, and solves the problems that sinapine is low in bioavailability, short in staying time in intestinal tracts and the like. the sinapine-loaded composite gel disclosed by the invention has ph independence, can form a large-area and uniform adhesion coating on intestinal tracts to mediate the sustained release of polyphenol, is beneficial to promoting the development of sinapine in the field of foods and medicines, and improves the comprehensive utilization of zein. according to the invention, the carrier advantage of corn protein is combined with the hydrophilic advantage of polyethylene glycol chain and the adhesiveness advantage of dopamine, the green and safe development concept is followed, and favorable conditions are created for the practical application of an oral delivery system of water-soluble drugs.

column10: non-linear pegylated lipid containing a tertiary amine and application thereof
column11: a non-linear pegylated lipid of the formula (1) contains a tertiary amine; wherein, b1 and b2 are linking bonds or alkylene groups; l1, l2, ld, and lx are linking bonds or divalent linking groups; r1 and r2 are c1-50 aliphatic hydrocarbon groups or c1-50 residues of aliphatic hydrocarbon derivatives, each containing 0-10 heteroatoms; y is 2 or 3; x is c or ch; xpeg is a polyethylene glycol component. compared with linear pegylated lipids, the pegylated lipid can realize better surface modification of lnp, better protective effects, extended systemic circulation of lnp, and significantly reduced biological toxicity of lnp. the lnp pharmaceutical composition shows excellent drug delivery capabilities. the lipid-nucleic acid pharmaceutical composition and its formulation exhibit higher pharmaceutical efficacy, especially the lnp-nucleic acid pharmaceutical composition.

column10: dual-stimulus-response polymer micelle as well as preparation method and application thereof
column11: the invention discloses a dual stimuli-responsive polymer micelle as well as a preparation method and application thereof. the micelle is jointly formed by a phenylboronic acid modified polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether-(alpha-propargyl-delta-valerolactone-lactide) copolymer and a catechol modified polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether-(alpha-propargyl-delta-valerolactone-lactide) copolymer, wherein the phenylboronic acid modified polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether-(alpha-propargyl-delta-valerolactone-lactide) copolymer is used for modifying the phenylboronic acid; when the micelle is formed, ph and ros can be formed in a hydrophobic core to stimulate corresponding boric acid ester bonds; the micelle is used for loading hydrophobic antitumor drugs. the polymer micelle prepared by the invention can be stable in an in-vivo circulating physiological environment, and makes stimulation response to a tumor microenvironment to cause structure loosening or dissociation, so that effective delivery of hydrophobic antitumor drugs is realized, the problems of instability of the micelle in vivo and drug pre-leakage are effectively solved, and the drug delivery efficiency is improved. theoretical and practical basis is provided for promoting cancer treatment of a polymer micelle drug delivery system.

column10: cationic lipid analogues, compositions and uses thereof
column11: a cationic lipid analogue, a composition and a use thereof. an aldehyde, an amine, a carboxylic acid and an isonitrile are adopted as raw materials to synthesize a cationic lipid analogue via the ugi reaction. the synthesized cationic lipid analogue, together with a sterol, an auxiliary lipid and a polyethylene glycol lipid derivative, further forms a nanoparticle-like lipid composition, which can be used for drug delivery, including the delivery of small molecule drugs, nucleic acid drugs such as mrna, dna, sirna, etc., protein/peptide drugs, and gene editing complexes such as mrna/sgrna, cas9/sgrna, etc. the nanoparticle-like lipid composition achieves mrna expressions in different organs of animals through different administration methods, and thus can meet the application requirements of mrna nucleic acid therapies, nucleic acid vaccines, gene editing, etc.

column10: cationic lipid compound, and preparation method therefor and use thereof
column11: the present application relates to the field of drug carriers, and specifically discloses a cationic lipid compound, and a preparation method therefor and a use thereof. the cationic lipid compound comprises a compound represented by formula i; in the formula i, n is equal to 1, 2, 3 or 4; r1 and r2 are each independently selected from secondary long-chain alkyl esters represented by formula ii; in the formula ii, n1=2, 4 or 6, n2=5, 7, 9 or 11, and n3=5, 7, 9 or 11. the cationic lipid compound is combined with phospholipids, cholesterol and polyethylene glycol lipids, such that an lnp carrier may be prepared, and then nucleic acid molecules are wrapped to prepare a corresponding drug. the raw materials for the production of the cationic lipid compound in the present application are easy to obtain, the synthesis steps are simple, the constructed lnp carrier has a good drug delivery effect, the corresponding drug can efficiently enter a target cell or activate an immune response of an organism, and thus the cationic lipid compound has practical application value.

column10: liposome, liposome nano-drug delivery system, preparation method of liposome nano-drug delivery system and application of liposome nano-drug delivery system in treatment of cervical cancer
column11: the invention provides a lipidosome. the lipidosome is prepared from phospholipid, cholesterol and distearoyl phosphatidyl ethanolamine-polyethylene glycol 2000-glutamine. the lipidosome is prepared from the phospholipid, the cholesterol and the distearoyl phosphatidyl ethanolamine-polyethylene glycol 2000-glutamine. the invention further provides a corresponding lipidosome nano-drug delivery system, a preparation method thereof and application of the lipidosome nano-drug delivery system in treatment of cervical cancer. by utilizing the difference between cervical cancer cells and normal cells, the glutamine is modified on the surface of the liposome, so that the accurate targeting of the drug on cervical cancer is realized. the lipidosome nano-drug delivery system has the advantages of good biocompatibility, low immunogenicity, high drug loading capacity, degradability and good stability, the circulation time in blood can be prolonged, and the cervical cancer treatment effect is improved at the same time.

column10: controlled-release pth compound
column11: the invention provides a method of treating or controlling hypoparathyroidism in a human patient by administering to the human patient a pharmaceutical composition comprising a controlled-release pth compound or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. the controlled-release pth compound comprises a pth moiety reversibly conjugated to a branched polyethylene glycol carrier. the composition is administered by subcutaneous injection no more frequently than once every 24 hours with a dosage of the controlled-release pth compound that corresponds to no more than 70% of the molar equivalent dose of pth 1-84 administered by subcutaneous injection at the same dosing frequency required to maintain a serum albumin-adjusted calcium level in serum of above 8.5 mg/dl over a 24 hour period.

column10: nano vaccine for in-situ antigen capture and lymph node targeted delivery as well as preparation method and application of nano vaccine
column11: the invention discloses a nano vaccine for in-situ antigen capture and lymph node targeted delivery as well as a preparation method and application of the nano vaccine. the nano vaccine comprises a polymer nano assembly and a drug, wherein the polymer nano assembly comprises an amphiphilic polymer and cationic liposome co-assembly; the amphiphilic polymer comprises a polyethylene glycol-polyphosphate segmented copolymer; the medicine comprises an immunologic adjuvant. the nano vaccine provided by the invention not only can be used for in-situ capture of tumor antigens, but also can carry antigens and immune agonists and deliver the antigens and immune agonists to tumor drainage lymph nodes in a targeted manner by utilizing the advantage of small size, so that the maturation of dendritic cells is promoted, the mature dendritic cells process the antigens and present the antigens to t cells, and cd8 + t cells are activated; and a strong anti-tumor immune response is induced.

column10: ha-aps (at) msn-pda-cs-mpeg nanoparticle and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention relates to an ha-aps (at) msn-pda-cs-mpeg nano particle and a preparation method of the nano particle. the invention relates to a preparation method of ha-aps (at) msn-pda-cs-mpeg nanoparticles. the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing mesoporous silica microspheres; (2) carrying out amination modification on the mesoporous silica microspheres, so as to obtain msn-nh2; (3) coating the msn-nh2 by using a pda-cs-mpeg (polyethylene glycol) copolymer, so as to obtain msn-pda-cs-mpeg (polyethylene glycol); (4) the msn-pda-cs-mpeg is subjected to hyaluronic acid modification, and ha (at) msn-pda-cs-mpeg is obtained, and ha (at) msn-pda-cs-mpeg is obtained; and (5) loading the astragalus polysaccharide on the ha (at) msn-pda-cs-mpeg, so as to obtain the ha-aps (at) msn-pda-cs-mpeg nano particles. according to the ha-aps-coated msn-pda-cs-mpeg nano particle and the preparation method thereof, mesoporous silica is used as a nano carrier, copolymer micelles formed by pda, cs and mpeg are coated on the surface of a silicon sphere, then ha modified by differentiated cluster protein c4dd is coated, finally astragalus polysaccharide is loaded, and a nano drug delivery system with a targeting effect is obtained by utilizing layer-by-layer structured modification. and the preparation method is high in universality.

column10: tofacitinib citrate sustained-release tablet and preparation method thereof

column10: preparation method of reversible covalent bond controlled slow-release bio-based nano-drug
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of a reversible covalent bond controlled slow-release bio-based nano-drug carrier. the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, oxidizing cellulose nanocrystals to obtain dialdehyde cellulose nanoparticles; reacting the dialdehyde cellulose nanoparticles with methoxy polyethylene glycol amine and sodium cyanoborohydride respectively to obtain cellulose nanoparticles grafted with a polyethylene glycol side chain; and finally, further covalently binding an amino-containing anti-cancer drug and the cellulose nanoparticles grafted with the methoxy polyethylene glycol side chain through a schiff base reaction to obtain the reversible covalent bond controlled slow-release bio-based nano-drug carrier based on the schiff base structure. the reversible covalent bond controlled slow-release bio-based nano-drug carrier obtained by the invention not only has high drug loading capacity, high salt tolerance and low cytotoxicity, but also realizes responsive release of the drug under an acidic condition, and can be used for targeting and slow-release treatment of cancer cells.

column11: the invention relates to the technical field of small molecule bonding drugs, in particular to an activated type methylene blue bonding drug which comprises an adriamycin-methylene blue bonding drug dox-mb and a 1-methyl-tryptophan-methylene blue bonding drug mt-mb. two bonding drugs dox-mb or mt-mb based on methylene blue are designed and synthesized, mt or dox is bonded with methylene blue through urea bonds, and the synthesis method is simple and easy to implement; the two bonding drugs dox-mb or mt-mb and the distearoyl phosphatidyl ethanolamine-polyethylene glycol are assembled in an aqueous solution to form the nano-drug, so that efficient loading of dox or mt can be realized; the bonding drug dox-mb or mt-mb has no cytotoxicity, and singlet oxygen generated by methylene blue under near-infrared laser irradiation or ultrasonic conditions can break urea bonds to release a parent drug, so that precise and controllable release and combined treatment of the drug are realized; the fluorescence of methylene blue in the bonding drug dox-mb or mt-mb is quenched, and the methylene blue fluorescence released by urea bond breakage under near-infrared laser irradiation or ultrasonic conditions is recovered, so that the method can be used for real-time detection of drug release.

[0001] the present invention belongs to the field of traditional chinese medicine, and particularly relates to a composition for preventing and/or treating rheumatoid arthritis as well as a preparation method and an application thereof.background art[0002] rheumatoid arthritis (ra) is a common autoimmune disease. its pathological characteristics are manifested as synovial inflammation and synovial tissue proliferation of joints. bone destruction, as an important feature of ra joint damage, mainly includes the damage and destruction of articular cartilages and bones. the problem of disability caused by bone destruction in ra patients in china is still severe, where a disability rate is up to 43.5% in the course of 5 to 10 years, and 90% in the course of 30 years. bone destruction caused by the inflammatory hyperplasia of the synovial joints is a core pathological link of rheumatoid arthritis, so how to effectively block bone destruction and reduce the disability rate is a difficulty to be urgently overcome in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.[0003] although western medicine treatment regimens can effectively control pathogenetic conditions in the short term, they are still not completely effective in stabilizing the conditions in the long term, especially in stopping the imago!ogical progression (i.e., stopping a process of bone destruction). disease-modifying antirheumatic dnigs (dmards) such as methotrexate (mtx) are first-line therapeutic dntgs for ra. early, adequate and combined use of dmards is the key to improve the prognosis of ra. however, 40% of patients have no response to early induction remission regimens. in addition, dmards are greatly limited, even resisted by patients, in long-term clinical applications due to their side effects such as gastrointestinal symptoms, bone marrow suppression, hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, infections, tumors and autonomic neuropathy, and poor tolerability. although new dmards such as biologies continue to make progress, there are still problems such as rapid short-term efficacy, unstable long-term efficacy, easy recurrence of patients' conditions, and incompletely clear safety due to a single -target effect, and high treatment price of biologies in china has brought a heavy economic burden to individual patients and society. at present, dmards, including the biologies, cannot effectively block or inhibit the pathological process of articular bone destruction in ra patients, resulting in a continuous progression of imagological changes under treatment.[0004] ra falls under a category of "arthralgia syndromes" in traditional chinese medicine. classic prescriptions such as radix astragali and ramulus cinnamomi five-drug decoction (including radix astragali, ramulus column10: broad-spectrum antibacterial sustained-release tablet and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention relates to the field of broad-spectrum long-acting bacteriostasis, in particular to a broad-spectrum bacteriostatic sustained-release tablet and a preparation method thereof. the broad-spectrum antibacterial sustained-release tablet is prepared from the following components: an antibacterial component, attapulgite powder, polyethylene glycol and water, wherein the antibacterial component is a mixed solution of carvacrol and cumin aldehyde or carvacrol; the weight volume ratio of the attapulgite powder to the antibacterial component is (10-50) g: 1ml; the weight ratio of the attapulgite powder to the polyethylene glycol is 2500: 1. the sustained-release tablet is a natural antibacterial preparation which is green, environment-friendly, efficient, broad-spectrum and capable of inhibiting bacteria for a long time, and the effective antibacterial time of the sustained-release tablet on neurospora crassa, aspergillus nidulans, aspergillus fumigatus and s. turmiunum can reach more than 40 days.

column10: nicodil film-controlled sustained-release tablet and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention provides a nicodil film-controlled sustained-release tablet and a preparation method thereof. the sustained-release tablet consists of a nicodil tablet core and a coating film coating the nicodil tablet core, the nicodil tablet core contains 5-30% of nicodil or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and the balance of auxiliary materials according to the weight of 100%; the coating film comprises the following raw materials: an insoluble coating material, a pore-foaming agent and/or a plasticizer; the insoluble coating material is selected from at least one of ethyl cellulose n50 and acrylic resin, the pore-foaming agent is selected from at least one of hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose, polyethylene glycol, fumaric acid, water-soluble inorganic salt, glycerin and saccharides, and the plasticizer is selected from at least one of polyethylene glycol and dibutyl sebacate. the nicodil film-controlled sustained-release tablet disclosed by the invention is simple in component, excellent in sustained-release performance and good in stability, and the preparation method is simple, convenient, feasible, short in time, low in cost and suitable for industrial production.

column10: hydrophilic fiber membrane with sustained-release drug and preparation method and use thereof
column11: the present disclosure provides a hydrophilic fiber membrane with a sustained-release drug, and belongs to the field of biological materials. the present disclosure provides a hydrophilic fiber membrane with a sustained-release drug, including a fiber with a core-shell structure, where a core of the fiber includes curcumin and a first spinnable polymer, and a shell of the fiber includes polyethylene glycol and a second spinnable polymer; and in the shell, the polyethylene glycol and the second spinnable polymer have a mass ratio of not greater than 1:12. in the present disclosure, the fiber membrane has a core-shell structure, the curcumin is provided in the core, and the shell prevents a rapid release of the curcumin in an early stage, thereby delaying a release rate of the curcumin to prevent the drug from forming a burst release in the early stage and causing toxic reactions.

column10: functionalized block polymer nano-drug carrier as well as preparation method and application thereof
column11: the invention provides a functionalized block polymer nano-drug carrier, the structural formula of the functionalized block polymer nano-drug carrier is as shown in # imgabs0, and the invention also provides a preparation method of the functionalized block polymer nano-drug carrier, which comprises the following steps: preparing a copolymer mpeg-cpa; the polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether amine and the 4-cyano-4-(phenyl carbonyl sulfide) valeric acid are subjected to esterification reaction to synthesize to obtain the 4-cyano-4-(phenyl carbonyl sulfide) valeric acid; a step of preparing a block polymer pmaa, wherein the copolymer mpeg-cpa is subjected to a reaction with a monomer methacrylic acid and 2-(methylthio) methacryloyl ethyl ester to obtain the block polymer pmaa; and a step of preparing the amphiphilic block polymer pei-pmaa, wherein the amphiphilic block polymer pei-pmaa is obtained by reacting the block polymer pmaa with polyethyleneimine. the nano-micelle is formed in water through self-assembly, has the advantages of excellent micelle stability, controllable nano shape, low toxicity and side effect, good drug controlled release and the like, and can be simultaneously used for combined delivery of biotherapy macromolecules such as proteins and genes and chemotherapy drugs.

column10: glycyrrhetinic acid modified block copolymer and application of glycyrrhetinic acid modified block copolymer as liver targeting drug carrier
column11: the invention discloses a glycyrrhetinic acid modified block copolymer and application of the glycyrrhetinic acid modified block copolymer as a liver targeting drug carrier. the block copolymer provided by the invention is provided for the first time and comprises a hydrophilic chain segment and a glycyrrhetinic acid modified hydrophobic chain segment, the hydrophilic chain segment is polyethylene glycol or polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether, and the hydrophobic chain segment is polyester of which a terminal hydroxyl group is esterified and modified by glycyrrhetinic acid. the block copolymer provided by the invention can be applied as a drug carrier material, and forms drug-loaded nano-micelles through self-assembly in an aqueous medium, so that the drug loading capacity, the solubility and the stability of hydrophobic drug molecules are remarkably improved; the active liver targeting characteristic is achieved, the medicine can be directionally conveyed to liver tissue, the treatment effect of the medicine is improved, and meanwhile the toxic and side effects of the whole body are effectively reduced.

column10: preparation method for constructing gold and silver heterogeneous nanocluster structure
column11: the invention provides a preparation method for constructing a gold and silver heterogeneous nanocluster structure, which comprises the following steps: mixing a gold nanocluster and a silver nanocluster, adding polyvinylpyrrolidone or polyethylene glycol, reacting in a dark place under high-frequency ultrasound, and dialyzing and purifying to obtain the gold and silver heterogeneous nanocluster. the invention also discloses the gold and silver heterogeneous nanocluster prepared by the preparation method. according to the preparation method disclosed by the invention, the spherical or porous gold and silver heterogeneous nanocluster structure is obtained by adding high polymer materials with different masses or volumes and cooperating with ultrasonic induction, so that directional control of the morphology of the gold and silver heterogeneous nanocluster and structural diversification preparation are realized. the gold and silver heterogeneous nanocluster structure also shows remarkable high loading performance and high biocompatibility, and can be used for drug delivery, image examination and the like. the synthesis method is simple, low in cost, capable of realizing mass synthesis, wide in application range and suitable for mass preparation of various hollow micro-nano materials.

column10: selenium-doped black phosphorus prodrug and preparation method therefor
column11: disclosed is a selenium-doped black phosphorus prodrug comprising selenium-doped black phosphorus nanosheets and polyethylene glycol amine coating the surface of the selenium-doped black phosphorus nanosheets. the selenium-doped black phosphorus nanosheets comprise black phosphorus nanosheets and selenium elements doped in the black phosphorus nanosheets, with the selenium elements replacing positions of a portion of the phosphorus atoms in the black phosphorus crystal lattice. the selenium-doped black phosphorus prodrug is a controlled-release prodrug of selenium elements, which can realize the near-infrared light controlled-release of selenium elements, thereby controllably regulating selenium content in the human body, regulating human immunity, and preventing and treating cancers. also provided is a method for preparing the selenium-doped black phosphorus prodrug.

column10: preparation process of controlled-release and long-acting film-coated fertilizer
column11: the invention discloses a preparation process of a controlled-release and long-acting film-coated fertilizer. the preparation process contains the following steps: mixing ammonium hydrogen carbonate,urea, calcium superphosphate, ammonium hydrogen phosphate, potassium chloride, potassium nitrate, sodium humate, zinc sulfate, magnesium sulfate and boric acid, and carrying out granulation, so as toobtain fertilizer particles; cleaning corn straws and sorghum straws, airing, crushing, drying, mixing the straws with glycerol, polyethylene glycol, tween 80, tungsten trioxide and concentrated sulfuric acid, stirring, and carrying out oil-bath heating, condensation reflux and centrifugal separation, so as to obtain a liquid product; uniformly mixing the liquid product with polyether polyol, microcrystalline wax, stannous octoate and triethylenediamine, so as to obtain a mixed solution; preheating the fertilizer particles, atomizing the mixed solution and polymethylene polyphenyl polyisocyanate, and alternately spraying the mixed solution and polymethylene polyphenyl polyisocyanate to the surfaces of the fertilizer particles, maintaining the temeperaure, and cooling. the fertilizer prepared by virtue of the preparation process has good fertilizer efficiency, is long in nutritional release period and capable of preserving moisture and fertility and has good ecological and economic benefits.

column10: method for preparing high-purity monocarboxyl-terminated polyethylene glycol
column11: the invention provides a method for preparing high-purity monocarboxyl-terminated polyethylene glycol. the method comprises the following steps: polyethylene glycol, maleic anhydride and an organic solvent are added to a reaction flask, nitrogen is introduced, stirring is carried out so that the solid is dissolved, the molar ratio of polyethylene glycol to maleic anhydride is 1: (1 to 1.5); pyridine is added, the temperature is controlled at 40-100 deg c, and the reaction is carried out for 1-6h; after the reaction is completed, an organic solvent is concentrated under reduced pressure, a concentrate is dropped into ice diethyl ether for precipitation, and the solid is washed by diethyl ether to obtain the white solid powder ho-peg2000-cooh. the method prepares the monocarboxyl-terminatedpolyethylene glycol by selecting appropriate reaction conditions, and the preparation method has the advantages of high selectivity, simple operation, easy availability of raw materials, mild conditions and high product purity. the quantitative analysis is carried out by a 1h-nmr method, the content of the monocarboxyl-terminated polyethylene glycol prepared by the method can reach more than 98%,and the monocarboxyl-terminated polyethylene glycol can be widely used in high-molecular synthesis, biomaterials, drug delivery systems and other fields.

column11: the invention relates to a preparation method of clarithromycin microcapsules. the preparation method comprises the following technological steps: 1), crushing clarithromycin granules until the bulk density of clarithromycin powder is close to that of carbomer, then uniformly mixing the fine clarithromycin powder with the carbomer, granulating according to a dry method, tableting, and sieving to obtain sustained-release coated clarithromycin microparticles; 2), dissolving a methacrylic acid copolymer in a mixed solution of isopropyl alcohol and polyethylene glycol to obtain an enteric coatingsolution; 3), putting the sustained-release coated clarithromycin microparticles obtained in the process 1) into a bottom-spray fluidized bed, sending the enteric coating solution obtained in the process 2) into the fluidized bed through bottom spraying after complete fluidization to complete enteric coating, and then continuing boiling drying in the fluidized bed to obtain the clarithromycin microcapsules meeting quality standards. according to the preparation method, the situation of swelling and bonding agglomeration of the carbomer when the carbomer is in contact with water is avoided, andthe density difference between the crushed clarithromycin and the carbomer is reduced, so that uniform mixing can be achieved. according to the preparation method of the clarithromycin microcapsules,a technology is simple and easy to implement, and industrial production is facilitated.

column10: polymer nanometer micelle with anaerobic response performance, and preparation method thereof

column10: preparation method of anti-tumor nanofiber drug membrane

column10: folic acid and ferrous tablet for pregnant women and wet nurses

column10: preparation method of double-loading pesticide nano microcapsule suspending agent
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of a double-loading pesticide nano microcapsule suspending agent. the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, diluting chlorantraniliprole raw medicine with deionized water, then adding polyvinyl alcohol and bovine serum albumin, and dissolving as a solid phase (s); diluting lambda-cyhalothrin with dichloromethane, adding polylactic acid, and dissolving to obtain an oil phase (o); diluting polyvinyl alcohol with deionized water to serve as an outer water phase (w); slowly pouring the solid phase s into an oil phase under high-speed shearing, shearing for one minute to form a water-in-oil primary emulsion, and carrying out ultrasonic emulsification on the obtained primary emulsion at certain power for three minutes to obtain a double-loading multiple emulsion system; and centrifuging for 10 minutes at a high speed of 10000 rpm for three times, discarding the supernate after each centrifugation, supplementing the same amount of deionized water for complete dispersion, and finally volatilizing at room temperature for 24 hours to obtain the double-loading pesticide nano microcapsule suspending agent. according to the method disclosed by the invention, the compounding power of different soluble pesticides is improved, and slow controlled release of the two pesticides is realized at the same time.

column10: plastic injection material and injection method thereof

column10: chlorpyrifos micro-capsule suspending agent adopting meso-porous silicon molecular sieve as carrier and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses a chlorpyrifos micro-capsule suspending agent adopting a meso-porous silicon molecular sieve as a carrier and a preparation technique thereof. the chlorpyrifos micro-capsule suspending agent adopting the meso-porous silicon molecular sieve as the carrier is characterized by comprising the following raw materials such as chlorpyrifos, polypropylene carbonate, polyvinyl alcohol, polylactic acid, gelatin, silicone oil emulsion, sodium alginate, organic bentonite, a mcm-41 molecular sieve, kh550, polyacrylic acid and hydrotalcite. in the chlorpyrifos micro-capsule suspending agent adopting the meso-porous silicon molecular sieve as the carrier and the preparation technique thereof, the organic bentonite and the sodium alginate are subjected to blending modification, intercalation is achieved, hydrophobicity and the adsorption effect are improved, and the organic bentonite and biodegradable material polylactic acid are combined into a wall material, so that a medicine controlled-release microcapsule is prepared. the mcm-41 molecular sieve is modified through the kh550 and serves as the carrier, the polyacrylic acid with a negative charge serves as a functional molecule, and through electrostatic adsorption, a controlled-release system is prepared. the layered hydrotalcite serves as a main body, microencapsulation chlorpyrifos serves as a guest molecule, an intercalation material is prepared, and the chlorpyrifos micro-capsule suspending agent is prepared.

column10: efficient controlled release fertilizer favorably improving taste and freshness of ivy mosses and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses an efficient controlled release fertilizer favorably improving taste and freshness of ivy mosses. the fertilizer comprises the following components in parts by weight: oyster shells, polylactic acid, expanded graphite, thermally activated nano chernozem, pinecones, pomegranate barks, mosses, sugarcane ash, a soil beneficial microbial inoculant, bacitracin zinc, phytase, amino acid, ground calcium ammonium sulfate, boric acid, sodium selenite, chelated iron, potassium fulvate, lysine, a proper amount of hydrogen peroxide, a proper amount of ammonia water, a proper amount of water and the like. the coated controlled release fertilizer is prepared by using the pinecones, the pomegranate barks, the mosses and the sugarcane ash which are matched with nutritional substances through fermentation. the fertilizer is rich in nutrient elements such as fermented small molecular organic matters, calcium, iron, selenium and zinc, is abundant in nutrient and convenient for plants to absorb and utilize, so that the taste and freshness of the ivy mosses can be enhanced; by adopting the coating layer which can supply oxygen and dynamically adjust the porosity, the fertilizer efficiency time is long, organic matter nutrients can be released for a long time, efficient cultivation of the ivy mosses can be realized, and the fertilizer can be widely applied and popularized.

column10: efficient controlled-release fertilizer capable of improving quality of virus-free potatoes and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses an efficient controlled-release fertilizer capable of improving the quality of virus-free potatoes. the efficient controlled-released fertilizer is prepared from the following components in parts by weight: oyster shell, polylactic acid, nano-viscous kaolin, sepiolite fabric, zanthoxylum oil dregs, aschersonia powder, bacteriophage powder, selenium-enriched yeast, white rot fungi, potassium sulphate, manganese sulfate, ferrous sulfate, ammonium sulfate, sodium borate, diammonium phosphate, fulvic acid, metalloprotease, ammonium tetrachlorocuprate, fish protein, indoleacetic acid, pepper leaf extract, herba portulacae extract, a proper amount of hydrogen peroxide, a proper amount of ammonium hydroxide and a proper amount of water. the sepiolite fabric, the zanthoxylum oil dregs, the aschersonia powder and the bacteriophage powder are matched with nutrients, and are fermented to prepare a film-coated controlled-release fertilizer; the fertilizer is rich in fermentation small molecular organic matters and natural sterilizing substances, is rich in nutrients, can be easily absorbed and utilized by potatoes, facilitates the synthesis, metabolism and growth of in-vivo protease, ensures safe culture of the virus-free potatoes, and can be widely applied and popularized.

column10: efficient cultivation fertilizer for lobular crowndaisy chrysanthemum and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses an efficient cultivation fertilizer for lobular crowndaisy chrysanthemum. the fertilizer comprises the following components in parts by weight: oyster shells, polylactic acid, common-rush-based porous biomass carbon, nano viscous loess, sisal hemp residues, distillers' grains, seaweed shells, leftovers of edible mushrooms, microbial zymophyte, melatonin, saponin, naphthylacetic acid, epsilon-polylysine, a proper amount of hydrogen peroxide, a proper amount of ammonia water, a proper amount of water and the like. the coated controlled release fertilizer is prepared by using the sisal hemp residues, the distillers' grains, the seaweed shells and the leftovers of the edible mushrooms which are matched with nutritional substances through fermentation. the fertilizer is rich in organic matters and abundant in nutrient; by adopting the coating layer which can supply oxygen and dynamically adjust the porosity, the fertilizer efficiency time is long, organic matter nutrients can be released for a long time, the photosynthesis and metabolism of the lobular crowndaisy chrysanthemum can be promoted, the quality of the lobular crowndaisy chrysanthemum can be improved, and efficient cultivation of the lobular crowndaisy chrysanthemum is realized. the materials of the coated fertilizer are wide in source, the price cost is low, the preparation process is simple to operate, the function is remarkable, and the fertilizer can be widely applied and popularized.

column10: efficient green chinese onion planting fertilizer rich in microelements and preparing method of efficient green chinese onion planting fertilizer
column11: the invention discloses efficient green chinese onion planting fertilizer rich in microelements. the efficient green chinese onion planting fertilizer comprises, by weight, oyster shells, polylactic acid, sodium bentonite, potassium mineral powder, manioc waste, furfural residues, oil residues, saccharomycetes, phosphobacteria, potassium bacteria, cytokinin, a proper amount of hydrogen peroxide, a proper amount of ammonium hydroxide and the like. the potassium mineral powder, the manioc waste, the furfural residues and the oil residues are adopted to be matched with nutrient substances, enveloping controlled release fertilizer is prepared after fermentation, the fertilizer is rich in organic matter, mineral elements and microelements, and nutrients are abundant. an enveloping layer capable of supplying oxygen and dynamically adjusting holes is adopted, the fertilizer effect time is long, organic matter nutrients can be released for a long time, metabolism of green chinese onions can be promoted, the nitrogen and phosphorus utilization rate of the green chinese onions is increased, the growth and photosynthesis of the green chinese onions are promoted, and the utilization efficiency of the green chinese onions for the fertilizer is improved, green chinese onion plants are stout and strong in meat quality, the content of proteins, cellulose, mineral elements and microelements is increased, the quality of the green chinese onions is improved, efficient cultivation of the green chinese onions is improved, and the green chinese onions can be widely popularized and applied.

column10: efficient sustained-release fertilizer capable of increasing content of soluble saccharides in carambola fruits and preparation method for efficient sustained-release fertilizer
column11: the invention discloses an efficient sustained-release fertilizer capable of increasing the content of soluble saccharides in carambola fruits. the efficient sustained-release fertilizer is prepared from the following ingredients in parts by weight: oyster shells, polylactic acid, white carbon black, activated white clay, plant oil residues, dry cattle manure, humus, deodorizing bacteria, saccharomycetes, ammonium phosphate, potassium sulfate, zinc sulfate, citric acid, borax, eucalyptol, potassium fulvate, compound amino acid initial powder, catechin, viscous starch paste, sodium lauryl sulfate, a proper volume of hydrogen peroxide, a proper volume of ammonia water and a proper volume of water. according to the efficient sustained-release fertilizer, the coated sustained-release fertilizer is prepared through enabling the activated white clay, the plant oil residues, the dry cattle manure and the humus to be matched with the eucalyptol, the catechin and the like and carrying out fermentation; and the fertilizer is rich in organic matters, a coating layer which can be used for supplying oxygen and dynamically adjusting pores is adopted, the nutrition is rich, and the fertilizer effect duration is long, so that nutrients can be released in long time, the growth and development of carambola fruits can be promoted, the increase of the content of the soluble saccharides in the carambola fruits is promoted, the efficient cultivation of the carambola fruits is promoted, and thus, the efficient sustained-release fertilizer can be extensively used and popularized.

column10: efficient controlled release fertilizer used for pollution-free fruit mulberries and preparation method thereof
column11: the invention discloses an efficient controlled release fertilizer used for pollution-free fruit mulberries. the efficient controlled release fertilizer comprises, by weight, oyster shells, polylactic acid, graphene, activated nano zeolite, marine microalgae slag, selenium and germanium-enriched spirulina slag, chlorella slag, kelp slag, bacillus subtilis, saccharomycetes, ferrous sulfate, boric acid, calcium ammonium nitrate, soy isoflavone, ammonium stearate, ammonium molybdate, ferrous sulfate, a proper amount of hydrogen peroxide, a proper amount of ammonia water and a proper amount of water. according to the efficient controlled release fertilizer, the marine microalgae slag, the selenium and germanium-enriched spirulina slag, the chlorella slag and the kelp slag are adopted to be matched with nutrient substances, and the coated controlled release fertilizer is prepared after enzymolysis and zymotechnics. the fertilizer is rich in fermentation micromolecule organic matter and microelements, the nutrition is rich and can be absorbed and utilized by the fruit mulberries conveniently, and growth of the fruit mulberries can be facilitated. the selenium and germanium nutrition is increased, and pollution-free cultivation of the fruit mulberries is guaranteed. a coating layer capable of supplying oxygen and dynamically adjusting pores is adopted, organic matter nutrients can be released for a long time, efficient cultivation of the fruit mulberries can be realized, and the efficient controlled release fertilizer can be widely applied and popularized.

column10: efficient controlled release fertilizer helping to improve awnless brome quality and product and preparing method thereof
column11: the invention discloses an efficient controlled release fertilizer helping to improve awnless brome quality and product. the efficient controlled release fertilizer is prepared from, by weight, oyster shell, polylactic acid, calotropis gigantean porous fiber-based biomass charcoal, nanometer viscidity tundra soil, plant straw, vinasse, chinese cabbage residue, degrease camellia seed pancake, nitrogen-fixing bacteria, saccharomycetes, selenious yeast extracts, potassium organo-carboxylate, rana japonica oil polypeptide, xanthatin, gum lac, an appropriate amount of hydrogen peroxide, an appropriate amount of ammonium hydroxide and an appropriate amount of water. according to the efficient controlled release fertilizer helping to improve the awnless brome quality and product, a coated controlled release fertilizer is obtained after the plant straw, vinasse, and chinese cabbage residue are adopted to coordinate with nutrient substances and are then subjected to fermentation, the coated controlled release fertilizer in self is rich in fermentation micromolecule organic matter, and rich in nutrition, and thus plants can conveniently absorb and utilize the fertilizer; meanwhile, the coated controlled release fertilizer is capable of making an awnless brome plant strong and promoting growth of the awnless brome plant, reducing diseases of the awnless brome plant, and improving the yield of the awnless brome plant; through the adoption of a coating layer capable of supplying oxygen and dynamically adjusting air voids, time of fertilizer efficiency is long, organic matter nutrients can be released for a long period, efficient cultivation of the awnless brome plant can be promoted, and thus the controlled release fertilizer can be put to a wide range of application and popularization.

column10: preparation process for sustained-release chlorine dioxide antibacterial film
column11: the invention discloses a preparation process for a sustained-release chlorine dioxide antibacterial film. the preparation process prepares a reaction type chlorine dioxide antibacterial film by using polyvinyl alcohol and polylactic acid as main base materials and compounding a film a and a film b through a wet process, wherein the film a is prepared through the following steps: selecting polyvinyl alcohol as a film-forming base material, preparing a polyvinyl alcohol gel aqueous solution by using a stable chlorine dioxide aqueous solution, then carrying out drying through a casting process so as to form a film, and with glycerol as a plasticizer, adding carboxymethyl cellulose so as to increase hygroscopicity of the film and promote the release of chlorine dioxide; and the film b is prepared through the following steps: selecting the polylactic acid as a film-forming base material, dissolving the polylactic acid with dichloromethane, adding one selected from the group consisting of an activator citric acid or tartaric acid into the obtained solution, adding a plasticizer and an antioxidant, and carrying out casting so as to form a film. the chlorine dioxide antibacterial film prepared by using the preparation process provided by the invention needs water to activate, thereby being able to be used as a packaging material of fruits and vegetables with high water content, wherein the water released by the respiratory action of the fruits and the vegetables activates a chlorine dioxide antibacterial agent, so the water in the package is reduced; meanwhile, the growth of microorganisms is inhibited; and the shelf life of the fruits and the vegetables is prolonged.

column10: preparation method of polylactic acid based medicine-carrying controlled release material
column11: the invention provides a preparation method of a polylactic acid based medicine-carrying controlled release material. the method comprises the following steps: dissolving levorotatory polylactic acid into a benign solvent of the levorotatory polylactic acid to obtain a skin-layer spinning raw solution; dissolving a target drug and racemic polylactic acid into a benign solvent of the racemic polylactic acid to obtain a core-layer spinning raw solution; obtaining double-component skin-core type medicine-carrying long fibers by using a double-component spinning method; then removing the solvent and dividing the long fibers into short fibers, namely the polylactic acid based medicine-carrying controlled release material. with the adoption of the method, by utilizing the difference of degrading performances of the polylactic acid with different configurations, the controlled release carrier material which meets different medicine controlled release time and is matched with a plurality of types of drugs is prepared through selecting polylactic acid skin-core layer raw materials with different molecular weights and configurations to control the length of the fibers; the preparation process is simple and is convenient for industrialized production.

column10: sustained-release microparticles containing poorly water-soluble drug and method for preparing the same
column11: problem to be solved: to provide sustained-release microparticles having a release profile which can effectively maintain the blood concentration of a drug over a long time, and at the same time allowing a smooth initial release after medication also when applying a hydrophobic drug.solution: the present invention relates to sustained-release microparticles containing a poorly water-soluble drug which contain a poorly water-soluble drug and a divalent or trivalent metal ion salt of polylactic acid comprising at least one carboxyl group at a terminal or a derivative thereof. the poorly water-soluble drug is entrapped into the divalent or trivalent metal ion salt of the polylactic acid or the derivative thereof. the sustained-release microparticles containing the poorly water-soluble drug have a particle diameter of 1-400 μm and contain no amphipathic block copolymer. preferably, the polylactic acid or the derivative thereof has a number average molecular weight of 500-5,000 dalton. preferably, the poorly water-soluble drug is olanzapine, risperidone, ziprasidone, rivastigmine, naloxone naltrexone, sirolimus, tacrolimus, or the like.

column10: sustained-release microsphere preparation containing recombinant hepatitis b virus surface antigen and preparation method of preparation
column11: the invention discloses a sustained-release microsphere preparation containing a recombinant hepatitis b virus surface antigen and a preparation method of the preparation. a kernel is composed of a stability protective agent and recombinant hepatitis b virus surface antigen particles, a high polymer material polylactic acid-polyglycolic acid block copolymer serves as an outer encapsulated layer, and the kernel and the outer encapsulated layer are combined to form the sustained-release microsphere preparation, wherein the stabilizer adopts mycose and human serum albumin. the preparation method comprises the steps that 1, the stabilizer and the recombinant hepatitis b virus surface antigen are mixed to obtain an inner water phase; 2, the polylactic acid-polyglycolic acid block copolymer is dissolved in organic solvent to be prepared into an oil phase, the inner water phase is added to the oil phase to be stirred and homogenized; 3, w/o initial emulsion is added to an outer water phase, and after stirring and homogenization are conducted, w/o/w multiple emulsion is formed; stirring is conducted for 4-6 h, centrifugal washing, collecting and vacuum freeze drying are conducted, and the preparation is obtained. according to tshe sustained-release microsphere preparation containing the recombinant hepatitis b virus surface antigen and the preparation method of the preparation, the problems that due to the fact that the immunogenicity of the hepatitis b virus surface antigen is destroyed in the preparation and releasing processes of microspheres, the antigen is denaturalized, and the immune effect is affected are solved.

column10: preparation method of health-care fiber containing nanometer selenium
column11: the invention discloses a preparation method of a health-care fiber containing nanometer selenium. the preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) adding a fiber forming polymer, namely polylactic acid, polyvinyl alcohol or polyacrylonitrile into a solvent, stirring the fiber forming polymer and the solvent until the fiber forming polymer is uniformly dissolved, after deaeration, adding nanometer selenium granules to the solution after deaeration, uniformly stirring the solution and the nanometer selenium granules, performing ultransonic deaeration through an ultrasonic processing device, and leaving the solution subjected to the ultransonic deaeration to stand so as to obtain a spinning stock solution; 2) pouring the spinning stock solution into a solution storing device, using a flush syringe needle as a capillary of a jet trickle, enabling the syringe needle and a high-voltage power supply to be connected to be used as an anode, wherein the flowing speed is 5*(10<-4>-10<-3>) mm/s, collecting fibers onto an earthing aluminum foil placed in front of the syringe needle, performing high-pressure electrostatic spinning, and performing vacuum drying at the normal atmospheric temperature so as to obtain the health-care fiber containing the nanometer selenium. the preparation method is simple and feasible, obtained products have a trace element, namely the selenium, required for a human body, and the health-care fiber can be processed into health-care textiles or a transdermal drug delivery system to be used for the human body.

column10: triple stimulation responsive core cross-linked polymeric micelle as well as preparation method and application thereof
column11: the invention discloses a triple stimulation responsive core cross-linked polymeric micelle as well as a preparation method and application thereof. the structural formula of the micelle is as shown in the description, wherein x is an integer of 30 to 70, y is an integer of 20 to 50 and the value of x1 is 20% to 50% of that of the x. according to the preparation method, an amphipathic diblock polymer is obtained through atom transfer radical polymerization (atrp), and is modified by utilizing an azidation reaction; an azidation product can self-assemble to form a core-shell structure in water;and the light, oxidation and reduction triple stimulation responsive core cross-linked polymeric micelle is obtained through click chemistry under the action of a cross-linking agent with redox sensitiveness, anhydrous cupric sulfate and sodium ascorbate. the triple stimulation responsive core cross-linked polymeric micelle provided by the invention has favorable in-vitro stability, can be used for realizing a high-efficiency controlled release behavior of a hydrophobic drug under the double stimulation of light and oxidation or reduction, and has favorable application prospects in the aspects of the delivery and the controlled release of a hydrophobic anti-cancer drug.

column10: preparation of novel amphipathic pectin-dihydroartemisinin nano particles
column11: the invention discloses preparation of novel amphipathic pectin-dihydroartemisinin nano particles, and belongs to the field of bio-pharmaceuticals and nano technologies. pectin (pet) is adopted as a carrier, carboxyl (-cooh) of the pectin is combined with hydroxyl (-oh) of dihydroartemisinin through an ester bond, the mixture and 10-hydroxycamptothecine (hcpt) are dissolved in an organic solvent together through purification, and polymeric micelle is obtained; nano particles are prepared, and the hydrophobic drug entrapped pectin-dihydroartemisinin/10-hydroxycamptothecine nano particles (pet-dha/hcpt nps) are prepared through the steps of ultrasonic treatment, centrifugation, washing, dialysis, freeze drying and the like. compared with existing research, the pectin is converted into the nano drug carrier from a single auxiliary material or cross-linking agent, the nano particles with the pectin loaded with a hydrophobic drug are transmitted, targeting is good, good dispersity is achieved, the drug loading capacity is high, high stability and good biodegradability are achieved, toxicity is low, and the novel amphipathic nano drug has a slow release function and can inhibit growth of multiple cancer cells, and cancer cell apoptosis is achieved. the preparation technology and process are short in period, cost is low, operation is convenient, and wide industrial prospects are achieved.

column10: sulfated hyaluronan fatty hydrocarbon amine
column11: the invention relates to a novel drug carrier-sulfated hyaluronan fatty hydrocarbon amine and an application thereof. the sulfated hyaluronan fatty hydrocarbon amine is formed by introducing a hydrophobic group-fatty hydrocarbon amine and a hydrophilic group-sulfate radical into a hyaluronan (ha) framework, has amphipathicity, can be self-assembled in water to form a polymeric micelle, and encapsulates indissolvable drugs, protein drugs and gene drugs. the sulfated hyaluronan fatty hydrocarbon amine has the characteristics of being capable of inhibiting tumor growth, easy to form drug-carrying polymer nanoparticles, high in stability, high in encapsulation efficiency, simple in preparation process, easy for large-scale production and the like.
